)

SELECT sname
FROM (
    SELECT st.sname,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sch.County ORDER BY st.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores st
    JOIN schools sch ON st.cds = sch.CDSCode
    WHERE sch.Virtual = 'F'
) ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, SUM(z.annual_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.annual_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND SUBSTR(T2.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS P1 ON T1.player_api_id = P1.player_api_id
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T2.date = T1.date
JOIN Player AS P2 ON T2.player_api_id = P2.player_api_id
WHERE P1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
  AND P2.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
  AND T1.date = '2013-07-12'
  AND T2.date = '2013-07-12';

SELECT SUM(M.home_team_goal) AS total_home_team_goals
FROM Match M
WHERE M.id IN (
    SELECT m.id FROM Match m JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_1 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) < 31
    UNION
    SELECT m.id FROM Match m JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_2 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) < 31
    UNION
    SELECT m.id FROM Match m JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_3 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) < 31
    UNION
    SELECT m.id FROM Match m JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_4 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) < 31
    UNION
    SELECT m.id FROM Match m JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_5 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) < 31
    UNION
    SELECT m.id FROM Match m JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_6 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) < 31
    UNION
    SELECT m.id FROM Match m JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_7 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) < 31
    UNION
    SELECT m.id FROM Match m JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_8 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) < 31
    UNION
    SELECT m.id FROM Match m JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_9 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) < 31
    UNION
    SELECT m.id FROM Match m JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_10 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) < 31
    UNION
    SELECT m.id FROM Match m JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_11 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) < 31
);

FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)

WITH high_vision_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE vision > 89
),
match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT DISTINCT C.name
FROM high_vision_players HVP
JOIN match_players MP ON MP.player_api_id = HVP.player_api_id
JOIN Country C ON C.id = MP.country_id;

SELECT C.name
FROM Country AS C
JOIN Match AS M ON C.id = M.country_id
JOIN Player AS P ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,

    M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11

FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

FROM Player_Attributes

LIMIT 5;

FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT c.name
FROM League l
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE l.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
  AND L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Alexis Blin'

FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team ON Team.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
ORDER BY TA.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_games
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
  AND Country.name = 'Italy'
  AND League.name = 'Serie A';

SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_score
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT PA.finishing, PA.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 4;

FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(PA.overall_rating) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT T4.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - T3.A11 AS gap
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN account AS T4 ON T2.account_id = T4.account_id
JOIN district AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY T1.birth_date ASC, T3.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) 
FROM disp d 
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id 
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' 
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('A', 'C')
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      WHERE l2.status IN ('A', 'C')
        AND strftime('%Y', l2.date) = '1997'
  );

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND T2.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
  AND date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995');

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND l.amount > 3000;

SELECT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT a.date
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840 AND t.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT T1.district_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.date = '1994-08-25' AND T2.status = 'A'

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN disp ON t.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.account_id = (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' 
  AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1996';

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832
  AND loan.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY d.A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT ((t1.balance - t2.balance) / t2.balance) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM trans t1
JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
WHERE t1.date = '1998-12-27'
  AND t2.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND t1.account_id = (
      SELECT account_id
      FROM loan
      WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
        AND status = 'A'
      ORDER BY loan_id
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) = 1993;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND di.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT district.A2 AS district, district.A3 AS region
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT l.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT loan.loan_id, district.A3 AS district, district.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.duration = 60;

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS state, ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(a."date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1993
   OR CAST(SUBSTR(a."date", 1, 2) AS INTEGER) + 1900 = 1993;

SELECT d.A2 AS district, COUNT(*) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

WITH cust_yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT cy.Segment, SUM(cy.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cy.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_yearly cy
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cy.Segment = m.Segment AND cy.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cy.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
JOIN transactions_1k t ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.ProductID = 2
ORDER BY t.Price / t.Amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.CustomerID, T2.Consumption FROM customers AS T1 JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Date = '201208' AND T1.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE ProductID = 5 AND Price / Amount > 29.00)
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_name, height FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating >= 60 AND overall_rating < 65 AND defensive_work_rate = 'low'
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT l.name
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T.team_long_name

JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND M.season = '2009/2010'
  AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal

ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT (DATETIME() - T1.birthday) AS age
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.date) >= '2013'

      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)

      JOIN Team AS T2 ON T2.team_api_id = TA2.team_api_id

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal)
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p1 ON m.home_player_1 = p1.player_api_id
JOIN Player p2 ON m.home_player_2 = p2.player_api_id
JOIN Player p3 ON m.home_player_3 = p3.player_api_id
JOIN Player p4 ON m.home_player_4 = p4.player_api_id
JOIN Player p5 ON m.home_player_5 = p5.player_api_id
JOIN Player p6 ON m.home_player_6 = p6.player_api_id
JOIN Player p7 ON m.home_player_7 = p7.player_api_id
JOIN Player p8 ON m.home_player_8 = p8.player_api_id
JOIN Player p9 ON m.home_player_9 = p9.player_api_id

SELECT l.loan_id,

       l.payments AS monthly_payment,
       l.duration,
       l.status,
       CASE l.status
            WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
            WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan not paid'
            WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running contract - OK so far'
            WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running contract - client in debt'
       END AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 1985 AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.ID FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND T3.Thrombosis = '0';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.C3 > 35
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.HCT <= 29 OR T3.HCT >= 52
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RNP IN ('-', '+-') AND Patient.Admission = '+'
SELECT Birthday FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')) ORDER BY Birthday DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
INNER JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID 
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F' 
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-','+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0') GROUP BY T1.ID ORDER BY MIN(T1.`First Date`) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.SSB IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID) FROM Laboratory t1 JOIN Examination t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID WHERE t1.SSB IN ('negative', '0') AND t2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA >= 8
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T1.Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GOT < 60
SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GPT < 60
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.GPT) DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT < 60 AND T1.SEX = 'M'
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.ID = (SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.LDH < 500 ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT MAX(T1.Date) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`First Date` = (SELECT MAX(`First Date`) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH >= 500));
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALP >= 300 AND T1.Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-' AND Laboratory.ALP < 300;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TP < 6.0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND T2.TP > 6.0 AND T2.TP < 8.5
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5

SELECT E.`aCL IgG`, E.`aCL IgM`, E.`aCL IgA`
FROM Examination AS E
INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA > 6.50
ORDER BY L.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT ID
FROM Examination
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRE < 1.5)
  AND `aCL IgA` = (
      SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`)
      FROM Examination
      WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRE < 1.5)
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Examination AS e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT T1.ANA FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` < 2.0 ORDER BY T2.`T-BIL` DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.`T-CHO` >= 250 AND T3.KCT = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` < 250 AND E.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG < 200 ORDER BY T2.TG DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 0 AND T2.CPK < 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CPK < 250

SELECT MIN(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU > 180
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GLU < 180 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '+' AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.PLT > 100 AND Laboratory.PLT < 400 AND Patient.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;
SELECT T1.PLT FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.PLT > 100 AND T1.PLT < 400 AND T2.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
SELECT AVG(T1.PT) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.PT < 14
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis IN (1, 2) AND T3.PT < 14

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_totals m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE t.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg_pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        pct_increase,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pct_increase DESC) AS r_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pct_increase ASC) AS r_asc
    FROM seg_pct
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase
FROM ranked
WHERE r_desc = 1 OR r_asc = 1
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

WITH target_account AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
      AND status IN ('A', 'C')          -- approved / running OK loans
    ORDER BY loan_id                    -- the first (earliest) approved loan on 1993/7/5
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_account ta ON t.account_id = ta.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC            -- end-of-day balance on that date
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_account ta ON t.account_id = ta.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC            -- end-of-day balance on that date
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (balance_end.balance - balance_start.balance) * 100.0 / balance_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end;

    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, t.total_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN -annual_avg END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN -annual_avg END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN -annual_avg END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM avgs;

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
            / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date,1,4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
biggest AS (
    SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage ASC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM biggest
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM lowest;

    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = t.account_id
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1)
  ) * 100.0
  /
  (SELECT balance
   FROM trans
   WHERE account_id = t.account_id
     AND date = '1993-03-22'
   ORDER BY trans_id DESC
   LIMIT 1) AS increase_rate

WITH cust_consumption AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment, cc.total_consumption
    FROM cust_consumption cc
    JOIN min_per_segment m 
        ON cc.Segment = m.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS pct_change
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT Segment, pct_change
FROM (SELECT Segment, pct_change FROM pct ORDER BY pct_change DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, pct_change
FROM (SELECT Segment, pct_change FROM pct ORDER BY pct_change ASC LIMIT 1);

JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT m.label, SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS result
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.element = 'ca'
);

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'c';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = 'TR151'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'

SELECT atom_id
FROM atom
WHERE element = 'c'
  AND CAST(substr(molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND CAST(substr(molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) <= 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h' AND m.label = '+';
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT bond.bond_type FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = 'TR007_4_19'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'

SELECT m.label AS carcinogenic,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND b.bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT T1.bond_id, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '#'
)
ORDER BY a.molecule_id, a.element;

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS total_double_bond_molecules,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ')

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN m.molecule_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage FROM bond

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'n' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T1.molecule_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR024';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.molecule_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2.molecule_id) AS cnt
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    ) t
);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h' AND a2.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-' AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = 'TR008' AND a.element = 'c'

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' AND a.element = 'o';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T1.element, T2.bond_type
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'o');
SELECT MAX("Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda'

FROM frpm AS T2
INNER JOIN schools AS T1 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T2.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
SELECT T2.MailStreet FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly Funded'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 400 AND schools.Virtual = 'F'
SELECT T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT T3.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T3 ON T1.cds = T3.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T2.`School Name`) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 560 AND T2.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'

SELECT T2."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"

JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 / T1.NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T2.NCESSchool FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T1.County = 'Alameda' AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100
SELECT T1.sname, T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.CharterNum FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.cname = 'Fresno'
  AND T1."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly Funded'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr <= 250
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Amador' AND `Low Grade` = '9' AND `High Grade` = '12'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles' AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
SELECT sname FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.School, T1.Street, T1.City, T1.Zip, T1.State FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1

SELECT T2.sname, T3.FundingType FROM satscores AS T2 JOIN schools AS T3 ON T2.cds = T3.CDSCode WHERE T3.County = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T2.sname HAVING AVG(T2.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip

JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800

SELECT s.sname AS School_Name, s.AvgScrWrite AS Average_Writing_Score, sc.Phone AS Communication_Number
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) AS INTEGER) > 1991
   OR (sc.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%Y', sc.ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) < 2000);

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT T2.OpenDate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND T1.`High Grade` = '12'

SELECT s.City, SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS total_enrollment

GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY total_enrollment ASC

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT T2.School, T2.Website FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.dname = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgc AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH cte AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment, (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS pct
    FROM cte
)

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total
    FROM (
        SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total,
               MIN(total) OVER (PARTITION BY Segment) AS min_total
        FROM totals
    ) t
    WHERE t.total = t.min_total
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct
    FROM seg
)
SELECT 'biggest' AS type, Segment, pct FROM pct
WHERE pct = (SELECT MAX(pct) FROM pct)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lowest' AS type, Segment, pct FROM pct
WHERE pct = (SELECT MIN(pct) FROM pct);

JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id

JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97

    WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
    WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
    WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
    WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
    WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg, c.CustomerID AS cid, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT seg, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY seg
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.seg, CAST(SUM(t.total_cons) AS REAL) / COUNT(t.cid) AS avg_cons
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON m.seg = t.seg AND m.min_cons = t.total_cons
    GROUP BY t.seg
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS "SME - LAM",
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS "LAM - KAM",
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') AS "KAM - SME";

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013 AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM seg
)
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT Segment, PercentageIncrease FROM pct ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT Segment, PercentageIncrease FROM pct ORDER BY PercentageIncrease ASC LIMIT 1
);

JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND T1.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT pa.date
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
      JOIN Player AS p2 ON pa2.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id
      WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY pa.date
LIMIT 1;
SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Willem II' AND TA.date = '2012-02-22'
SELECT buildUpPlayDribblingClass FROM Team_Attributes JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id WHERE Team.team_short_name = 'LEI' AND Team_Attributes.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00';

SELECT T.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS T
JOIN Team ON Team.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND T.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT TA.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle'
  AND TA.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00'

SELECT T.chanceCreationCrossingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS T
JOIN Team ON Team.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Hull City'
  AND T.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND substr(T1.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT ((SELECT PA.overall_rating
         FROM Player_Attributes PA
         JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
         WHERE P.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND PA.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')
        -
        (SELECT PA.overall_rating
         FROM Player_Attributes PA
         JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
         WHERE P.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND PA.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'))
       * 100.0 /
       (SELECT PA.overall_rating
        FROM Player_Attributes PA
        JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
        WHERE P.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND PA.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') AS percentage
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE (strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(birthday))) > 34;

SELECT SUM(M.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Player AS P ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11)
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT SUM(T1.away_team_goal)
FROM Match AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2
  ON T2.player_api_id IN (T1.away_player_1, T1.away_player_2, T1.away_player_3, T1.away_player_4, T1.away_player_5, T1.away_player_6, T1.away_player_7, T1.away_player_8, T1.away_player_9, T1.away_player_10, T1.away_player_11)
WHERE T2.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira');

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(T2.birthday)) < 31;
SELECT T2.player_name FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T1.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT DISTINCT T2.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.attacking_work_rate = 'high'

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.finishing = 1
ORDER BY julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - julianday(datetime(T1.birthday)) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id IN (T2.home_player_1, T2.home_player_2, T2.home_player_3, T2.home_player_4, T2.home_player_5, T2.home_player_6, T2.home_player_7, T2.home_player_8, T2.home_player_9, T2.home_player_10, T2.home_player_11, T2.away_player_1, T2.away_player_2, T2.away_player_3, T2.away_player_4, T2.away_player_5, T2.away_player_6, T2.away_player_7, T2.away_player_8, T2.away_player_9, T2.away_player_10, T2.away_player_11)
JOIN Country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Match m ON pa.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT C.name
FROM Country AS C
JOIN Match AS M ON M.country_id = C.id
JOIN Player AS P ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
GROUP BY C.name
ORDER BY AVG(P.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T.team_long_name FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow'
SELECT T.team_short_name FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'

SELECT AVG(P.height)
FROM Player AS P
WHERE P.player_api_id IN (
    SELECT MP.pid
    FROM (
        SELECT home_player_1 AS pid, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_2, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_3, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_4, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_5, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_6, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_7, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_8, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_9, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_10, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_11, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_1, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_2, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_3, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_4, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_5, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_6, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_7, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_8, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_9, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_10, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_11, country_id FROM Match
    ) AS MP
    JOIN Country AS C ON C.id = MP.country_id
    WHERE C.name = 'Italy'
);
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990'
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left')
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes;
SELECT C.name FROM Country C JOIN League L ON C.id = L.country_id WHERE L.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'

SELECT PA.sprint_speed, PA.agility, PA.acceleration
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' AND League.name = 'Italy Serie A';
SELECT MAX(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'
SELECT T1.finishing, T1.curve FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player)

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND district.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a 
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' 
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id);
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A11 > 6000 AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT D.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - DI.A11 AS gap
FROM client C
JOIN district DI ON C.district_id = DI.district_id
JOIN disp D ON C.client_id = D.client_id
WHERE C.gender = 'F'
  AND C.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND DI.A11 = (SELECT MIN(DI2.A11)
                FROM client C2
                JOIN district DI2 ON C2.district_id = DI2.district_id
                WHERE C2.gender = 'F'
                  AND C2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'));

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT DISTINCT client.client_id
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND disp.type = 'Disponent';

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      WHERE l2.status = 'A'
        AND strftime('%Y', l2.date) = '1997'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
        AND strftime('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.date < '1997-01-01' AND T2.balance > 3000;
SELECT client.client_id FROM client JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE card.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT a.date
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840 AND t.date = '1998-10-14';
SELECT account.district_id FROM account JOIN loan ON loan.account_id = account.account_id WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25' AND loan.status = 'A';

SELECT MAX(t.amount)
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21'
);

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
ORDER BY di.A11 DESC, c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT disp.disp_id
FROM disp
JOIN trans ON disp.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 5100 AND trans.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' 
  AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1996';

SELECT d.A2 FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03';
SELECT account.account_id FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague' ORDER BY account.date LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.client_id) 
FROM client AS T1 
WHERE T1.district_id = (
    SELECT T2.district_id 
    FROM district AS T2 
    WHERE T2.A3 = 'south Bohemia' 
    ORDER BY T2.A4 DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE status = 'A' AND date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
b1 AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
    LIMIT 1
),
b2 AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1998-12-27'
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (b2.balance - b1.balance) * 100.0 / b1.balance
FROM b1, b2;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT c.client_id, a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2, d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT account.account_id, district.A2, district.A3
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.amount > 300000;

SELECT loan.loan_id, district.A3, district.A11
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.duration = 60;

SELECT d.A2, d.A3, ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) = '1993' OR SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 2) = '93';
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT district.A2, COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM client
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY district.A2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c 
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id 
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id 
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id 
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' 
  AND dt.A3 = 'South Bohemia' 
  AND c.client_id NOT IN (
      SELECT d2.client_id 
      FROM disp d2 
      JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d2.disp_id
  );

SELECT d.A3
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(loan.amount) FROM loan JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id WHERE client.gender = 'M';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY A16 DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' 
  AND loan.amount >= 250000 
  AND loan.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' 
  AND loan.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) 
FROM loan l 
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id 
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D') AND a.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(t.monthly_amount) AS avg_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS monthly_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)
) t;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON ct.Segment = m.Segment
     AND ct.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH t AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           y.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
m AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM t
    GROUP BY Segment
),
a AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_cons
    FROM t
    JOIN m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT (SELECT avg_cons FROM a WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM a WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS "SME-LAM",
       (SELECT avg_cons FROM a WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM a WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS "LAM-KAM",
       (SELECT avg_cons FROM a WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM a WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS "KAM-SME";
