JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND T2.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) 
FROM Player AS T1 
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id 
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' 
  AND SUBSTR(T2.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT
  (
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player p
     JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')
    -
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player p
     JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')
  ) * 100.0 /
  (SELECT pa.overall_rating
   FROM Player p
   JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%');
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal)
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p ON p.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'
WHERE p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11
);

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p
  ON p.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira');

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) 
FROM Match AS T1 
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 
ON (T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id 
    OR T1.home_player_2 = T2.player_api_id 
    OR T1.home_player_3 = T2.player_api_id 
    OR T1.home_player_4 = T2.player_api_id 
    OR T1.home_player_5 = T2.player_api_id 
    OR T1.home_player_6 = T2.player_api_id 
    OR T1.home_player_7 = T2.player_api_id 
    OR T1.home_player_8 = T2.player_api_id 
    OR T1.home_player_9 = T2.player_api_id 
    OR T1.home_player_10 = T2.player_api_id 
    OR T1.home_player_11 = T2.player_api_id) 
WHERE (strftime('%Y', datetime('now', 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(T2.birthday))) < 31;

SELECT T2.player_name 
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id 
ORDER BY T1.overall_rating DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.finishing = 1
ORDER BY julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime')) - julianday(T1.birthday) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country C ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT T2.name
FROM League AS T1
JOIN Country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id
JOIN Match AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.league_id
JOIN Player AS T4 ON T3.home_player_1 = T4.player_api_id
GROUP BY T2.name
ORDER BY AVG(T4.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(T2.height)
FROM Match AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id
JOIN Country AS T3 ON T1.country_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.name = 'Italy';
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990'
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23);

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) AND preferred_foot = 'left'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT T_home.team_long_name AS home_team, 
       T_away.team_long_name AS away_team, 
       M.home_team_goal, 
       M.away_team_goal
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team T_home ON M.home_team_api_id = T_home.team_api_id
JOIN Team T_away ON M.away_team_api_id = T_away.team_api_id
WHERE M.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' 
  AND L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT PA.sprint_speed, PA.agility, PA.acceleration
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT T_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS T_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team.team_api_id = T_Attributes.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match 
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id 
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A' 
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';
SELECT MAX(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'

SELECT Player_Attributes.finishing, Player_Attributes.curve
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT L.name AS league_name, COUNT(M.id) AS num_games
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN (
    SELECT away_team_api_id, SUM(away_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id
) AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.total_goals = (
    SELECT MAX(total)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(away_team_goal) AS total
        FROM Match
        GROUP BY away_team_api_id
    )
);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
GROUP BY P.player_name
HAVING MAX(PA.overall_rating) = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' 
         ELSE '1996' 
       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT T2.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - MIN(T3.A11) AS gap
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN district AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id
JOIN account AS T4 ON T2.account_id = T4.account_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F');

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district t ON c.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND t.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'Disponent';

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('A', 'C')
  AND l.date LIKE '97%'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(amount)
      FROM loan
      WHERE status IN ('A', 'C')
        AND date LIKE '97%'
  )
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT account_id
FROM account
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1993'
  AND account_id IN (
      SELECT account_id
      FROM loan
      WHERE duration > 12
        AND amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan WHERE duration > 12)
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND di.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE date = (
    SELECT MIN(date)
    FROM trans
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id 
FROM account AS T1 
INNER JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) < '1997' AND T2.balance > 3000

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25'
  AND loan.status = 'A';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21'
);

SELECT gender
FROM client
WHERE client_id IN (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE account_id IN (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM account
        WHERE district_id = (
            SELECT district_id
            FROM district
            ORDER BY A11 DESC
            LIMIT 1
        )
    )
)
ORDER BY birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.date = '1998-09-02' AND t.amount = 5100;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a 
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice' 
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832 AND loan.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND d.A4 = (SELECT MAX(A4) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia');

SELECT (T1.balance - T2.balance) * 100.0 / T2.balance AS increase_rate
FROM trans AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.account_id = (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM loan
        WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
        ORDER BY loan_id
        LIMIT 1
      )
  AND T1.date = '1998-12-27'
  AND T2.date = '1993-03-22';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) = 1993
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT T1.account_id, T1.frequency
FROM account AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T4.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND T2.type = 'OWNER'
  AND SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 2) IN ('95', '96', '97', '98', '99', '00');

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT account.account_id, district.A2 AS district, district.A3 AS region
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3, d.A11
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS state,
    ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.account_id) AS percentage
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.date) = '1993';

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(*) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND cd.card_id IS NULL;

SELECT d.A3 AS district
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.amount)
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN disp AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id
WHERE T4.gender = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(d.A16, ',', '') AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.account_id)
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND account.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM card 
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id 
WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
  AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_total) AS avg_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS year_month, SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY year_month
);

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND substr(t.date, 1, 2) = '98'
  AND t.amount < (
      SELECT AVG(amount)
      FROM trans
      WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND substr(date, 1, 2) = '98'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = disp.client_id

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT COUNT(ID) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F') 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) > '1930'

  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio_outpatient_to_inpatient
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date

    (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)

    SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.Consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT cz.Segment, SUM(cz.Consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk cz
    JOIN mins m ON m.Segment = cz.Segment AND m.min_consumption = cz.Consumption
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
            / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, percentage
FROM pct
WHERE percentage = (SELECT MAX(percentage) FROM pct)
   OR percentage = (SELECT MIN(percentage) FROM pct)
ORDER BY percentage DESC;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
b_early AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id
    LIMIT 1
),
b_late AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    (b_late.balance - b_early.balance) * 100.0 / b_early.balance AS increase_rate
FROM b_early, b_late;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT czk_2013.Segment,
           SUM(czk_2013.total_consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM czk_2013
    JOIN min_cons ON min_cons.Segment = czk_2013.Segment
                 AND min_cons.min_total = czk_2013.total_consumption
    GROUP BY czk_2013.Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_average
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HigherThanNormal,

FROM Laboratory

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- All CZK customers' monthly consumption records for 2013
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption per segment in 2013
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_avg AS (
    -- Annual average consumption of the lowest-consuming customers:
    -- total consumption / number of customers with the lowest consumption
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment
     AND t.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH segment_pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM segment_pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase,
    (SELECT Segment FROM segment_pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC  LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase;

  AND p2.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' 
         ELSE '1996' 
       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS salary_gap
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);

SELECT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
ORDER BY client.birth_date DESC, district.A11 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT d.client_id
FROM disp d

JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
JOIN hero_power AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T4 ON T3.power_id = T4.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T4.power_name = 'Agility'

INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GLU > 180;

JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.GLU < 180

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT cz.Segment, cz.CustomerID, cz.Consumption
    FROM czk cz
    JOIN mins m ON cz.Segment = m.Segment
               AND cz.Consumption = m.min_consumption
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           CAST(SUM(Consumption) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_difference,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_difference,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_difference;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT cu.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers cu ON ym.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID
    WHERE cu.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND cu.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY cu.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS pct_increase
    FROM seg
)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT Segment, pct_increase FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT Segment, pct_increase FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1);

WITH extremes AS (
    SELECT MAX(height) AS max_height, MIN(height) AS min_height
    FROM Player
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name, p.height, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    CROSS JOIN extremes e
    WHERE p.height = e.max_height OR p.height = e.min_height
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name, p.height
)
SELECT player_name, height, avg_finishing
FROM candidates
WHERE avg_finishing = (SELECT MAX(avg_finishing) FROM candidates);

FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'LEI'
  AND TA.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle'
  AND Team_Attributes.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00';

SELECT ta.chanceCreationCrossingClass
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hull City'
  AND ta.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT ta.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND ta.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT
    (LD.overall_rating - JB.overall_rating) * 100.0 / LD.overall_rating AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes AS LD
JOIN Player AS PD
    ON PD.player_api_id = LD.player_api_id
JOIN Player_Attributes AS JB
    ON JB.date = LD.date
JOIN Player AS PB
    ON PB.player_api_id = JB.player_api_id
WHERE PD.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
  AND PB.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
  AND LD.date = '2013-07-12';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player
ORDER BY weight DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_team_goals
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
    m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
    m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11
)
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Player AS p
    WHERE p.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira')
      AND p.player_api_id IN (
          m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
          m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10,
          m.away_player_11
      )
);

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Player AS p
    WHERE p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11
    )
    AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime') - STRFTIME('%Y', p.birthday)) < 31
);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.finishing = 1
ORDER BY julianday(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime') - julianday(P.birthday) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m
  ON p.player_api_id IN (
      m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
      m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
      m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
      m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
  )
JOIN Country c
  ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON PA.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country C ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON m.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

WITH italy_matches AS (
    SELECT m.*
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
),
italy_players AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italy_matches
)
SELECT AVG(p.height) AS avg_height
FROM Player p
JOIN italy_players ip ON p.player_api_id = ip.player_api_id;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(id) AS num_players
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  );

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM League l
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE l.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'

SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match m 
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id 
WHERE l.name = 'Italy Serie A' 
  AND m.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT MAX(m.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_score
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY COUNT(Match.id) DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Match M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS year_with_higher_percentage
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT DISTINCT
       a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MAX(c2.birth_date)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district di2 ON c2.district_id = di2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND di2.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)
  );

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.date LIKE '1997%'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount = (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM loan WHERE date LIKE '1997%');

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date LIKE '1993%'
  AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan WHERE duration > 12);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND di.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id
FROM trans t
WHERE t.date = (
    SELECT MIN(t2.date)
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1995'
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT a.date
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840 AND t.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT a.district_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.date = '1994-08-25';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE CAST(c.issued AS DATE) = '1996-10-21'
);

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id
                      FROM loan
                      ORDER BY amount DESC
                      LIMIT 1)
  AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM disp d
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT district.A2
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY d.A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT (t_later.balance - t_early.balance) * 100.0 / t_early.balance AS increase_rate
FROM trans t_early
JOIN trans t_later 
    ON t_early.account_id = t_later.account_id
   AND t_early.date = '1993-03-22'
   AND t_later.date = '1998-12-27'
WHERE t_early.account_id = (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
      AND l.status IN ('A', 'C')   -- approved loans
    ORDER BY l.loan_id ASC          -- first approved loan on that date
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT T1.account_id, T2.A2, T2.A3
FROM account AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 2) = '93';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT l.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3, d.A11
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district,
       d.A3 AS state,
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_decin
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) = 1993;

SELECT d.A2 AS district,
       COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
LEFT JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND card.card_id IS NULL;

SELECT d.A3 AS district
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
);

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id IN (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      WHERE A15 = (
          SELECT MAX(A15)
          FROM district
          WHERE A15 < (SELECT MAX(A15) FROM district)
      )
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM card 
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id 
WHERE card.type = 'gold' 
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a 
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN "order" o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek' AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO';

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_total) AS avg_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%m', date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY strftime('%m', date)
) AS monthly;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (
      SELECT AVG(amount)
      FROM trans
      WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1998'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS female_accounts_in_south_bohemia
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A3 = 'south Bohemia';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT d.type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND di.A11 > 8000
  AND di.A11 <= 9000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ';

SELECT AVG(d.A15)
FROM district d
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 1997
  );

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'classic'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c 
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha' AND c.gender = 'M';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', issued) AS INTEGER) < 1998 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan);

SELECT d.A15
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.account_id = 532;

SELECT a.district_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE o.order_id = 33333;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount < 200000;

SELECT c.type
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
WHERE cl.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY num_accounts DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
FROM `order` o
JOIN disp d ON o.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE o.order_id = 32423;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Jesenik';

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'junior'
  AND c.issued >= '1997-01-01';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
       SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS credit_card_withdrawals
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND date >= '1996-01-01';

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') 
  - (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference

SELECT d.type, COUNT(*) AS num_dispositions
FROM disp d
WHERE d.account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
GROUP BY d.type;

SELECT t.k_symbol, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS num_statements
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id = 3
GROUP BY t.k_symbol
HAVING SUM(t.amount) = 3539;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.loan_id,
       l.amount AS debt_amount,
       l.payments AS monthly_payment,
       l.duration,
       l.status AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT t.balance AS sum_after_transaction, c.gender
FROM trans t
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE t.trans_id = 851
  AND disp.client_id = 4;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 9;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.type = 'withdrawal';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1983 AND 1987
  AND di.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND c.birth_date BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_junior_card_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_male
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_clients
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 24
  AND T2.amount = (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM loan WHERE duration > 24)

SELECT T2.account_id
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN district AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY T1.birth_date ASC, T3.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a 
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id

JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.client_id,
    CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM bond b
   JOIN connected c  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
   JOIN atom a1      ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
   JOIN atom a2      ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
   WHERE a1.element || a2.element =
         (SELECT a1.element || a2.element
          FROM connected c2
          JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c2.atom_id
          JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c2.atom_id2

          ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM cust_totals
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON ct.Segment = m.Segment AND ct.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')

  LIMIT 1

JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Description
ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT t.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.ProductID = 2
ORDER BY t.Price * 1.0 / t.Amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.CustomerID, T2.Date, T2.Consumption FROM transactions_1k AS T1 JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.ProductID = 5 AND T1.Price / T1.Amount > 29.00 AND T2.Date = '201208'

WITH losses AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS loss_count
    FROM Match
    WHERE season = '2015/2016'
      AND (home_team_goal - away_team_goal) < 0
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id
)
SELECT T.team_long_name AS home_team, L.loss_count
FROM losses L
JOIN Team T ON T.team_api_id = L.home_team_api_id
WHERE L.loss_count = (SELECT MIN(loss_count) FROM losses);

SELECT CASE
           WHEN t.avg_finishing > s.avg_finishing THEN t.player_name
           ELSE s.player_name
       END AS player_name
FROM
    (SELECT p.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
     FROM Player p
     JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
     GROUP BY p.player_name
     LIMIT 1) t
    CROSS JOIN
    (SELECT p.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
     FROM Player p
     JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
     GROUP BY p.player_name
     LIMIT 1) s;
