JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id = 3;

SELECT a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour eye ON s.eye_colour_id = eye.id
JOIN colour hair ON s.hair_colour_id = hair.id
WHERE eye.colour = 'Blue'
  AND hair.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.superhero_name IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy');
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN eye_colour_id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(superhero_name) AS percentage
FROM superhero;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS S JOIN gender AS T1 ON S.gender_id = T1.id
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero);
SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'cryokinesis';
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE id = 294;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Helen Parr';

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.weight_kg = 108
  AND s.height_cm = 188;

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
ORDER BY hero_attribute.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.alignment, p.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue'

SELECT AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS avg_attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.alignment_id = 3;

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id = 1 AND gender_id = 2;

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg = 0 OR T1.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND s.superhero_name = 'Hulk';

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE gender.gender = 'Female' AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name FROM superhero INNER JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Wind Control' ORDER BY superhero.superhero_name ASC;

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
ORDER BY s.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS fastest_hero_count
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT a.attribute_name
FROM attribute a
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero);
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'John%';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_inpatient,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_outpatient,
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = '30609';

SELECT P.SEX, P.Birthday, E.`Examination Date`, E.Symptoms
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH > 500;

SELECT T1.ID, (strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';
SELECT T1.ID, T2.SEX, T2.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T2 JOIN Examination AS T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND L.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT Patient.ID, SEX, Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND (CAST(T2.TP AS REAL) < 6.0 OR CAST(T2.TP AS REAL) > 8.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50;
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997' AND Admission = '-'
SELECT MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(`Birthday`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) FROM `Patient`

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND T2.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F';
SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4)) - MIN(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200);

SELECT E.Symptoms, E.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = (
    SELECT MAX(P2.Birthday)
    FROM Patient AS P2
    WHERE P2.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination)
)
AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) / 12 AS average_male_patients_per_month
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND p.SEX = 'M';

SELECT T2.Date, CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18 
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday))
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T2.Date) BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.`Examination Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID AND T1.`Examination Date` = T3.Date
WHERE T3.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory);
SELECT ANA FROM Examination WHERE ID = 3605340 AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02'
SELECT SEX FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS' ORDER BY `First Date` ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9'
SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'
SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13' AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND strftime('%Y', T2.`Date`) = '1995'

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT e.`Symptoms`
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-03-01'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993-09-27';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Laboratory.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN Laboratory.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Laboratory.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN Laboratory.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18';
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%' AND strftime('%Y', Description) >= '1997' AND strftime('%Y', Description) < '1998';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' AND T2.GPT > 30 AND T2.ALB < 4
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S' 
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND Laboratory.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND Laboratory.`T-BIL` < 2.0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P' AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989';
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT AVG(T1.ALB) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.PLT > 400 AND T2.SEX = 'F' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM Examination
        WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
        GROUP BY Symptoms
    ) AS t
);
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE strftime('%Y', DATE) = '1997' AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.WBC < 3.5

SELECT julianday(`Examination Date`) - julianday(`First Date`)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA > 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA > 6.5) AS is_normal
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.ID = 57266;
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = '48473' AND GOT >= 60
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1994' AND T2.GOT < 60

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GPT > 60)
ORDER BY Birthday ASC
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Admission FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALP < 300
SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TP < 6.0;

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALB, CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Albumin_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) * 100.0
   FROM Laboratory AS T1
   JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
   WHERE T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA > 6.5)
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F') AS percentage

SELECT AVG(l.UA)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
    FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.ID = p.ID
)
AND (
    (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
    OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
);

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS result
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` = (SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) FROM Laboratory);
SELECT T1.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.SEX

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) / COUNT(ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `T-CHO` >= 250);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) > 50
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.CPK < 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU >= 180 AND T2."T-CHO" < 250;
SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991' AND T2.GLU < 180

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.WBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday DESC;
SELECT P.ID, P.Diagnosis, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.RBC < 3.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0)

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.HGB < 10;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.HGB > 10 AND T2.HGB < 17
GROUP BY T1.ID, T1.SEX
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT >= 52

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE a.element
        WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
        WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
        WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'
        WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
        WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
        WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
        WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
        WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
        WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
        WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
        WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'
        WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
        WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
        WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
        WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
        ELSE a.element
    END AS element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';
SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule) AS percentage_of_triple_bond_compounds;

WITH admins AS (
    -- Collect every administrator first name together with the school's district
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName1) <> ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT AdmFName2, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName2) <> ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT AdmFName3, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName3) <> ''
),
top_two AS (
    -- The two most frequent administrator first names overall
    SELECT first_name
    FROM admins
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
-- Show those names and the district(s) they administer in
SELECT a.first_name,
       a.District,
       COUNT(*) AS administrator_count
FROM admins a
WHERE a.first_name IN (SELECT first_name FROM top_two)
GROUP BY a.first_name, a.District
ORDER BY a.first_name, administrator_count DESC;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- 2013 consumption records of customers who pay in CZK, tagged with segment
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312        -- Year 2013
),
min_consumption AS (
    -- The lowest consumption value found in each segment for 2013
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(Consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total 2013 consumption of the least-consuming
    -- customers / number of those customers, per segment
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 AS z
    JOIN min_consumption AS m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment
     AND z.Consumption = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,

    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,

    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH station_unit_price AS (

    SELECT
        g.GasStationID,
        g.Country,
        AVG(t.Price * 1.0 / t.Amount) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN gasstations g
        ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
    GROUP BY g.GasStationID, g.Country
),
overall_unit_price AS (
    -- Overall average price per unit across all transactions
    SELECT AVG(Price * 1.0 / Amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM transactions_1k
)
SELECT
    s.Country,
    COUNT(*) AS value_for_money_stations
FROM station_unit_price s
CROSS JOIN overall_unit_price o
WHERE s.avg_unit_price < o.overall_avg
GROUP BY s.Country
ORDER BY value_for_money_stations DESC;

     - SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0

SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) AS match_players
JOIN Player  p ON p.player_api_id = match_players.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id            = match_players.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts

WHERE c.gender = 'F'

FROM client

WHERE client.gender = 'M'

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id  = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest = earliest (smallest) birth date, per the hint
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
  -- lowest average salary among those oldest female clients
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (
                SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                FROM client
                WHERE gender = 'F'
              )
      );

        SELECT MIN(l2.amount)

        ORDER BY l.amount DESC

SELECT d.disp_id

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT district.A2

JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'

SELECT c.birth_date

JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT

FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY d.A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1

SELECT
    ((t_end.balance - t_start.balance) * 100.0) / t_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN trans t_start
     ON t_start.account_id = l.account_id
    AND t_start.date = '1993-03-22'
JOIN trans t_end
     ON t_end.account_id = l.account_id
    AND t_end.date = '1998-12-27'
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'          -- loan approved on 1993/7/5
ORDER BY l.loan_id ASC               -- "first" loan approved on that date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'

SELECT DISTINCT

    T1.frequency
FROM account AS T1

SELECT a.account_id, a.date

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT

JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT

    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT

    d.A3 AS district,
    d.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT 
    d.district_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    ((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12) AS unemployment_rate_increment_percentage

JOIN account a

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

JOIN disp disp ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id

SELECT A3 AS branch_location,

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id

WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_total) AS avg_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
           SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.BIRTHDAY) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(L.ALB) AS average_albumin
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.PLT > 400
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT Symptoms, COUNT(Symptoms) AS NumOfSymptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE YEAR(DATE) = '1997'
  AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT
    SUM(Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%') * 100.0
        / SUM(Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%') AS proportion
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE YEAR(BIRTHDAY) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'

  AND P.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT DATEDIFF(e.`Examination Date`, p.`First Date`)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA > 8.0) 
           OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA > 6.5) 
         THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS uric_acid_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.ID = 57266;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = '48473'
  AND GOT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1994'
  AND T2.GOT < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.GPT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT > 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    Patient.ID, 
    (YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.Admission
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALP < 300;

SELECT T1.ID, 
       T2.ALP < 300 AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TP < 6.0;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    T2.Date,
    T1.SEX,
    T2.TP,
    T2.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM 
    Patient AS T1
JOIN 
    Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE 
    T1.SEX = 'F'
    AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.UA > 6.5 THEN l.ID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.`Date` = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.`Date`)
        FROM Laboratory l2
        WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
      )
  AND (
        (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
     OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l

WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND l.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`)
    FROM Laboratory
);

SELECT 
    p.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT p.ID          AS patient_id,
       l.`T-CHO`     AS t_cho_index

JOIN Laboratory l
     ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`)

LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT

INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal,

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_molecules_with_triple_bonds
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+' AND T1.element = 'o';

SELECT 
    `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS Eligible_Free_Rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY Eligible_Free_Rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
  AND f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1;

SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
  AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores 
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 400 
  AND schools.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT s.School
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores AS sa
JOIN schools AS s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sa.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sc.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (
    SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`)
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f 
    ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(
           frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
       ) AS highest_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores
    ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.NumGE1500 / satscores.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / t.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    s.School,
    s.NCESSchool,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.District
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' 
  AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged' 
  AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT 
    sc.School,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) 
FROM schools AS T1 
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T1.City = 'Fresno' 
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded' 
  AND T2.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `County Name` = 'Amador' 
  AND `Low Grade` = 9 
  AND `High Grade` = 12;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    schools.School,
    schools.Street,
    schools.City,
    schools.Zip,
    schools.State
FROM frpm
JOIN schools 
    ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30;

SELECT DISTINCT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0;

SELECT T3.School,
       T3.FundingType
FROM schools AS T3
INNER JOIN satscores AS T1
        ON T3.CDSCode = T1.cds
WHERE T3.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T3.School, T3.FundingType
HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(*) > 400;

SELECT s.School,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT 
    T2.sname, 
    T2.AvgScrWrite, 
    T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.OpenDate) > '1991' 
   OR STRFTIME('%Y', T1.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCTYPE
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.City,
    SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS Total_Enrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY Total_Enrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_FRPM_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.DOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    f.`School Name`,
    s.Website
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' 
  AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    T2.AdmFName1,
    T2.AdmLName1,
    T2.AdmFName2,
    T2.AdmLName2,
    T2.AdmFName3,
    T2.AdmLName3
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s 
    ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 / t.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Website
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND t.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sname
FROM (
    SELECT
        sc.sname,
        sh.County,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY sh.County
            ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC
        ) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sc
    JOIN schools sh
        ON sh.CDSCode = sc.cds
    WHERE sh.Virtual = 'F'
) ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT s.EILName
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    sc.School,
    st.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools sc
JOIN satscores st ON sc.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE (sc.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich');

SELECT T2.School, T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) / 12 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = '52'
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = 54 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = 52 THEN 1 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND County = 'Orange';

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
        SELECT County
        FROM schools
        WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
        GROUP BY County
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1
      );

SELECT s.sname AS School_Name, sc.MailStreet AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT T2.MailStreet, T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) AS total_schools
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND (T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr) AS total_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.MailCity = 'Fresno';

SELECT School, MailZip
FROM schools
WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' 
  AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian';

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 END) AS ratio_colusa_to_humboldt
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA'
  AND StatusType = 'Active'
  AND City = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT s.Phone, s.Ext
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) 
FROM schools 
WHERE City = 'Hickman' 
  AND Charter = 1 
  AND DOC = 52;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM frpm AS F
JOIN schools AS S ON F.CDSCode = S.CDSCode
WHERE S.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND S.Charter = 0
  AND F.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / F.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT 
    AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Administrator1,
    AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Administrator2,
    AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Administrator3,
    School,
    City
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = 1
  AND CharterNum = '00D2';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schools
FROM schools
WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman'
  AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.FundingType = 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
    / COUNT(s.FundingType) AS locally_funded_percentage
FROM schools s
WHERE s.County = 'Santa Clara';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE County = 'Stanislaus' 
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded' 
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total_Closures
FROM schools
WHERE DOCType = 'Community College District'
  AND ClosedDate LIKE '1989%'
  AND City = 'San Francisco';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11                                        -- Youth Authority Facilities (CEA)
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT StatusType,
       COUNT(*) AS NumberOfSchools
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alpine'
  AND SOCType = 'District Community Day School'
GROUP BY StatusType;

SELECT NCESDist
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Fresno'
  AND Magnet = 0;

SELECT frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND schools.City = 'Fremont'
  AND frpm.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015';

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.DOCType = 'Youth Authority Facilities (YAF)'
  AND schools.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE NCESDist = 0613360
  AND EdOpsCode = 'SPECON';

SELECT 
    schools.EILName AS `Educational Level Name`,
    frpm.`School Name`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools 
    ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`County Code` = '37';

SELECT T2.City
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND T1.`Low Grade` = 9
  AND T1.`High Grade` = 12
  AND T1.`County Name` = 'Merced'
  AND T2.EILCode = 'HS';

SELECT 
    s.School,
    f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-9'
  AND s.County = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT County, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT School, Latitude, SOCType
FROM schools
ORDER BY Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.City,
    f.`Low Grade`,
    s.School
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN s.Magnet = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS magnet_multiple_provision_count,
       s.City,
       COUNT(*) AS num_K8_schools
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
GROUP BY s.City;

SELECT AdmFName1, AdmFName2, AdmFName3, District
FROM schools
GROUP BY AdmFName1, AdmFName2, AdmFName3
ORDER BY COUNT(AdmFName1) DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT
    f.`District Code`,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

SELECT
    s.AdmLName1 AS Administrator_Last_Name,
    s.District,
    s.County,
    s.School
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.CharterNum = 40;

SELECT AdmFName1, AdmLName1, AdmEmail1,
       AdmFName2, AdmLName2, AdmEmail2,
       AdmFName3, AdmLName3, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 62                                -- Intermediate/Middle Schools
  AND DOC = 54                                -- Unified School
  AND County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010';

SELECT 
    sc.AdmEmail1 AS admin_email,
    s.sname AS school_name
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DisplayName, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS UserCount
FROM users
WHERE UpVotes > 100
  AND DownVotes > 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
WHERE Views > 10
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CreationDate) AS INTEGER) > 2013;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS PostCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT posts.Title
FROM posts
INNER JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT u.DisplayName AS Owner
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.FavoriteCount = (SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts);

SELECT SUM(p.CommentCount) AS TotalComments
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT MAX(posts.AnswerCount) AS MaxAnswerCount
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS RootPostCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND p.ParentId IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Age > 65
  AND posts.Score >= 20;

SELECT users.Location
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON posts.Id = tags.ExcerptPostId
WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id
ORDER BY tags.Count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(b.Id) AS BadgeCount
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT DISTINCT badges.Name
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND strftime('%Y', badges.Date) = '2011';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(badges.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(users.DisplayName) AS AverageBadges
FROM users
LEFT JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE users.Views > 200;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE T1.Score > 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS vote_count
FROM votes
WHERE UserId = 58
  AND CreationDate = '2010-07-19';

SELECT CreationDate
FROM votes
GROUP BY CreationDate
HAVING COUNT(Id) = (
    SELECT MAX(VoteCount)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(Id) AS VoteCount
        FROM votes
        GROUP BY CreationDate
    ) AS Counts
);

SELECT posts.Title
FROM posts
JOIN comments ON posts.Id = comments.PostId
ORDER BY comments.Score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS NumComments
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE p.ViewCount = 1910;

SELECT p.FavoriteCount

GROUP BY SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM yearmonth AS T1

WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME'
  AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
GROUP BY SUBSTR(T1.Date, 5, 6)

WITH czk_2013 AS (                       -- CZK customers' consumption in 2013
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_per_segment AS (                     -- lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (                          -- avg = total consumption / count of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON m.Segment = z.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = z.Consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
     - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
       (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
     - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
       (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
     - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    -- Total consumption per segment for 2012 and 2013 (EUR customers only)
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    -- Apply the hint's formula: (2013 - 2012) / 2013 * 100
    SELECT
        Segment,
        cons_2012,
        cons_2013,
        (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS pct_change
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT
    Segment,
    cons_2012,
    cons_2013,
    ROUND(pct_change, 2) AS pct_change
FROM pct
WHERE pct_change = (SELECT MAX(pct_change) FROM pct)
   OR pct_change = (SELECT MIN(pct_change) FROM pct);

SELECT  T1.account_id,
        (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
        -
        (SELECT MIN(A11)
         FROM district
         WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id
                               FROM client
                               WHERE gender = 'F'
                               ORDER BY birth_date DESC
                               LIMIT 1)
        ) AS salary_gap
FROM    client AS T2
JOIN    disp    AS T1 ON T2.client_id  = T1.client_id
JOIN    account AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE   T2.gender = 'F'
  AND   T2.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND   T2.district_id = (SELECT district_id
                          FROM client
                          WHERE gender = 'F'
                          ORDER BY birth_date DESC
                          LIMIT 1);

SELECT
    (( CAST(late.balance AS REAL) - early.balance ) * 100.0 / early.balance ) AS increase_rate
FROM
    -- Balance on date B: 1993-03-22
    (SELECT balance
     FROM trans
     WHERE account_id = (
             SELECT account_id
             FROM loan
             WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
               AND status IN ('A', 'C')        -- approved loans
             ORDER BY loan_id                  -- the FIRST approved loan that day
             LIMIT 1)
       AND date = '1993-03-22'
     ORDER BY trans_id DESC                    -- last transaction of that day
     LIMIT 1) AS early,

    -- Balance on date A: 1998-12-27
    (SELECT balance
     FROM trans
     WHERE account_id = (
             SELECT account_id
             FROM loan
             WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
               AND status IN ('A', 'C')
             ORDER BY loan_id
             LIMIT 1)
       AND date = '1998-12-27'
     ORDER BY trans_id DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS late;

SELECT a.attribute_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM superhero s2
      JOIN hero_attribute ha2 ON ha2.hero_id = s2.id
      WHERE s2.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
  );

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN alignment.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_good
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT hero_id
FROM hero_attribute
ORDER BY attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'More in-patients'
        ELSE 'More outpatients'
    END AS comparison,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS inpatient_to_outpatient_ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = '30609';

SELECT 
    P.SEX, 
    P.Birthday, 
    E.`Examination Date`, 
    E.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH > 500;

SELECT T1.ID,
       CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND L."T-CHO" >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS REAL) * 100
       / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Patient) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND (T2.TP < '6.0' OR T2.TP > '8.5');

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Admission` = '+'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`Birthday`) AS INTEGER)) >= 50;

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997'
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT strftime('%Y', `First Date`) - strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS `Age`
FROM Patient
ORDER BY Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997' 
  AND T2.Thrombosis = '1' 
  AND T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = (
        SELECT MAX(p2.Birthday)
        FROM Patient p2
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM Examination e2 
            WHERE e2.ID = p2.ID
        )
      )
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) / 12 AS avg_male_patients_per_month
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT 
    L.Date,
    CAST(SUBSTR(P.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_first_arrival
FROM Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN Patient AS P 
    ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_patients
FROM (
    SELECT T1.ID
    FROM Patient AS T1
    JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
    GROUP BY T1.ID
    HAVING MIN(
        CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER)
        -
        CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
    ) >= 1
) AS eligible_patients;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 18
  AND SUBSTR(`Examination Date`, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age,
       T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T3.ID = T1.ID
WHERE T3.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT ANA
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = 3605340
  AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN `T-CHO` < 250 THEN 'Yes, normal level'
         ELSE 'No, abnormal level'
       END AS total_cholesterol_status
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 2927464
  AND Date = '1995-09-04';

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY `First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT DISTINCT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT COUNT(lab.ID) AS total_lab_tests
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS lab ON p.ID = lab.ID
WHERE p.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND lab.Date LIKE '1995%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959/3/1'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993/9/27';

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(l.`T-CHO`)
   FROM Laboratory l
   JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
   WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
     AND l.Date LIKE '1981-11-%')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(l.`T-CHO`)
   FROM Laboratory l
   JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
   WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
     AND l.Date LIKE '1981-12-%') AS decrease_rate;

SELECT DISTINCT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND Description >= '1997-01-01'
  AND Description < '1998-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND L.GPT > 30
  AND L.ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS patient_count,
       ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND e.`aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2
        FROM Examination
      );

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
       / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
WHERE `U-PRO` > 0 AND `U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT SUM(DIAGNOSIS = 'BEHCET') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', `First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989';

SELECT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND l.CRP > 2
  AND l.CRE = 1
  AND l.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(T2.ALB)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T2.PLT > 400
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT MAX(T1.Symptoms) AS Most_Common_Sign
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_APS_patients
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND Diagnosis = 'APS';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory
WHERE strftime('%Y', DATE) = '1997'
  AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100
    / SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND Examination.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND Patient.Admission = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND T2.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT JULIANDAY(e.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(p.`First Date`) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA > 8.0) 
           OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA > 6.5) 
         THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS uric_acid_within_normal_range
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.ID = 57266;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = '48473'
  AND GOT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GOT < 60
  AND strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1994';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.GPT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GPT > 60
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT 
       Patient.ID, 
       (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALP < 300;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALP,
       CASE 
           WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT
    Patient.ID,
    Patient.SEX,
    Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory
    ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TP < 6.0;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    P.ID, 
    P.SEX, 
    P.Birthday, 
    P.Description, 
    P.[First Date], 
    P.Admission, 
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID,
       CASE
           WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
           ELSE 'Not within normal range'
       END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN L.UA > 6.5 THEN P.ID END)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID),
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.UA IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P 
    ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID          -- latest lab exam per patient
      )
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)   -- normal range for male
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)   -- normal range for female
      );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F') AS result
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM Laboratory);

SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT L.ID,
       L."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
ORDER BY L."T-CHO" DESC,   -- highest total cholesterol first
         P.Birthday ASC    -- among ties, the oldest (earliest) birthday first
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) / COUNT(P.ID) AS Average_Age
FROM 
    Patient AS P
WHERE 
    P.SEX = 'M'
    AND P.ID IN (
        SELECT ID 
        FROM Laboratory 
        WHERE `T-CHO` >= 250
    );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-'
  AND T2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    P.ID, 
    P.SEX, 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180
  AND L."T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Description) AS INTEGER) = 1991
  AND T2.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5 OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY P.SEX ASC, P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       p.Diagnosis,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND Laboratory.HGB < 10;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.HGB > 10
  AND L.HGB < 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.ID,
       strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID, T2.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(T1.ID) > 2;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_lower_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_higher_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
      - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 50
  AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
     / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pct_female_abnormal_PT
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    P.`First Date`,
    P.Admission,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) > 1992
  AND L.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' 
  AND T2.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.APTT > 45
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.WBC > 3.5
  AND L.WBC < 9.0
  AND (L.FG <= 150 OR L.FG >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` >= 30
);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
