SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY L.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGA > 80
  AND Laboratory.IGA < 500
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(Patient.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGM <= 40 OR L.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY P.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(P.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRP = '+'
  AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 1985
  AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND E.Thrombosis = '0';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.C3 > 35
  AND T3.[ANA Pattern] = 'P';

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory  AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE NOT (T3.HCT > 29 AND T3.HCT < 52)
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RNP IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Laboratory AS l
     ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
WHERE Patient.ID IN (
        SELECT Laboratory.ID
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE Laboratory.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
      )
  AND Patient.`First Date` = (
        SELECT MIN(Patient.`First Date`)
        FROM Patient
        WHERE Patient.ID IN (
                SELECT Laboratory.ID
                FROM Laboratory
                WHERE Laboratory.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
              )
      );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.DNA >= 8;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900
  AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000
  AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.GOT < 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) AS Youngest_Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT < 60
GROUP BY T1.ID, T1.Birthday
ORDER BY MAX(T2.GPT) DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS male_patients
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT < 60
  AND P.SEX = 'M';

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS first_recorded_date
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(L.Date) AS latest_medical_data_date
FROM Laboratory AS L
WHERE L.ID = (
    SELECT P.ID
    FROM Patient AS P
    JOIN Laboratory AS Lab ON P.ID = Lab.ID
    WHERE Lab.LDH >= 500
    ORDER BY P.`First Date` DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_admitted_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALP >= 300
  AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.ALP < 300;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TP < 6.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' 
  AND T2.TP > 6.0 
  AND T2.TP < 8.5;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB = (
    SELECT MAX(ALB)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT E.`aCL IgG`, E.`aCL IgM`, E.`aCL IgA`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.UA <= 6.50
ORDER BY L.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS Highest_ANA
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.ANA
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` < 2.0
ORDER BY T2.`T-BIL` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` >= 250
  AND e.KCT = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` < 250
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG < 200
    ORDER BY TG DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L  ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 0
  AND L.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CPK < 250
  AND (T2.KCT = '+' 
       OR T2.RVVT = '+' 
       OR T2.LAC = '+');

SELECT MIN(P.Birthday) AS Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU > 180;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.GLU < 180
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '+'
  AND Laboratory.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.PLT > 100 
  AND T2.PLT < 400 
  AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;

SELECT L.PLT
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND L.PLT > 100
  AND L.PLT < 400;

SELECT AVG(L.PT) AS average_prothrombin_time
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis IN (1, 2)
  AND l.PT < 14

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecule_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT AVG(a.element = 'o') AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '-') / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN atom      ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'na'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100
       / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS carcinogenic_count
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
  AND label = '+';

SELECT a1.element AS element_atom1,
       a2.element AS element_atom2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'h'
GROUP BY T2.label
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.label) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c 
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b 
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
HAVING COUNT(a.element) = (
    SELECT MIN(element_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS element_count
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '-'
        GROUP BY a2.element
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8');

SELECT DISTINCT label
FROM molecule
WHERE label NOT IN (
    SELECT m.label
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'sn'
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.element IN ('i', 's')
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN atom src ON c.atom_id = src.atom_id
WHERE src.molecule_id = 'TR181';

SELECT 100.0
       - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN a.molecule_id END) * 100.0
         / COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)                        AS pct_not_fluorine
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '#') * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT element
FROM (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
    GROUP BY element
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 3
) AS top3
ORDER BY element ASC;

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
       a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
       a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6'
  AND a1.molecule_id = 'TR001';

SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
ORDER BY m.label ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT T2.element, T1.label
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR060';

SELECT b.bond_type,
       m.label,
       COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
            ELSE 'not carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR009'
  AND (c.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'br';

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    a.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Not carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25'
  AND T2.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'p'
  AND a2.element = 'n';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(c.bond_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(c.atom_id) AS avg_num_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'i';

SELECT bond.bond_type, bond.bond_id
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE SUBSTR(atom.atom_id, 7, 2) + 0 = 45;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id  FROM connected)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT A.element
FROM atom AS A
JOIN connected AS C

    OR A.atom_id = C.atom_id2
WHERE C.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds

JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '='

LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id

SELECT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2

JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT
  100.0 * (
      SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM connected c
      JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
      JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
      GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1

SELECT

    5) AS carcinogenic_single_bond_pct
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 's';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'sn';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND a.element IN ('p', 'br');

SELECT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT SUM(T3.element = 'cl') / COUNT(T3.atom_id) AS percent
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '+'
  AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR030';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'i';

SELECT MAX(label) AS result
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'ca'
);

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS has_both_cl_and_c
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
    OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond      ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom      ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'        -- non-carcinogenic
  AND bond.bond_type = '#'        -- triple bond
  AND atom.element = 'c'          -- carbon atom
LIMIT 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(a.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a 
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id 
    OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS num_non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) AS element_count
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio,
    m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'c';

SELECT a1.element AS element_1,
       a2.element AS element_2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN m.molecule_id END)
         / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id),
         2
       ) AS pct_compounds_with_triple_bond
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b
       ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR151'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule 
    ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(molecule.molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(molecule.molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) <= 50;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
       / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR124';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
     FROM bond b 
     WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
       AND b.bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes, carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'no, non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a 
    ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
)
ORDER BY a.molecule_id, a.element;

SELECT
    CASE a1.element
        WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'  WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
        WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'  WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
        WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'    WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
        WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
        WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'   WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
        WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'    WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
        WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'      WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
        WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    END AS first_atom_element,
    CASE a2.element
        WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'  WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
        WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'  WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
        WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'    WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
        WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
        WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'   WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
        WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'    WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
        WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'      WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
        WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    END AS second_atom_element
FROM connected AS conn
JOIN atom AS a1 ON conn.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON conn.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE conn.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS chlorine_bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
   OR a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id)
     FROM bond
     WHERE bond_type = ' = ')                                          AS molecules_with_double_bond,

    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
     FROM bond b
     JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
     WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' AND m.label = '+')                      AS carcinogenic_molecules_with_double_bond;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS molecule_count
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT a.molecule_id
        FROM atom a
        WHERE a.element = 's'          -- exclude molecules containing sulphur
      )
  AND m.molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT b.molecule_id
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.bond_type = '='        -- exclude molecules having a double bond
      );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN m.molecule_id END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a 
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE (connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2')
   OR (connected.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_1');

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2
  ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / COUNT(c.bond_id) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+' AND T2.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's'
  AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T2.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T2
JOIN atom AS T1 ON T2.molecule_id = T1.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '-'
GROUP BY T2.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T1.molecule_id) > 5

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b   ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a   ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
  AND m.label = 'TR024';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(molecule.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM connected
JOIN bond    ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = connected.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = connected.atom_id2
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE a1.element = 'h'
  AND a2.element = 'h'
  AND bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_single_bonds
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_carbons
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR008'
  AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR004_7'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'o';

SELECT MAX(T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS `highest eligible free rate`
FROM frpm AS T1
WHERE T1.`County Name` = 'Alameda'

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cds) AS num_schools
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND sc.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND s.Charter = 1
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM satscores
JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumGE1500 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 / satscores.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    s.NCESSchool,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT  sc.District,
        AVG(sa.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
FROM    schools AS sc
JOIN    satscores AS sa 
        ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE   sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY sc.District
ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2
  ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sc.CharterNum
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
  AND T1.cname = 'Fresno'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode)
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Amador'
  AND `Low Grade` = 9
  AND `High Grade` = 12;

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    schools.School,
    schools.Street,
    schools.StreetAbr,
    schools.City,
    schools.Zip,
    schools.State
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE (frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;

SELECT DISTINCT s.School
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm      AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND t.NumGE1500 > 0;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM satscores AS st
JOIN schools AS s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING SUM(st.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(st.cds) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND s.School LIKE '%High School%';

SELECT 
    s.sname, 
    s.AvgScrWrite, 
    sc.Phone
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', sc.OpenDate) > '1991' 
   OR STRFTIME('%Y', sc.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
        -- Average enrollment difference across locally funded schools
        SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
        FROM frpm AS f2
        INNER JOIN schools AS s2 
            ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
        WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
      )
  AND s.FundingType = 'Locally funded';

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT 
    frpm.`School Name`,
    frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)`
FROM schools
JOIN frpm 
    ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Website
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT 
    frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE (schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (schools.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (schools.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson');

SELECT schools.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS FullName1,
       AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS FullName2,
       AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS FullName3

WITH czk_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, CZK payers only
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        y.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consuming
    -- customer(s) / number of such customers, per segment
    SELECT
        t.Segment,
        SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_totals t
    JOIN segment_min m
      ON m.Segment = t.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = t.total_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

        / PA_Landon.overall_rating AS percentage_difference
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA_Landon
INNER JOIN Player AS P_Landon 
        ON PA_Landon.player_api_id = P_Landon.player_api_id
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA_Jordan 
        ON PA_Landon.date = PA_Jordan.date
INNER JOIN Player AS P_Jordan 
        ON PA_Jordan.player_api_id = P_Jordan.player_api_id
WHERE P_Landon.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
  AND P_Jordan.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
  AND PA_Landon.date LIKE '2013-07-12%';

SELECT player_name
FROM (
    SELECT player_name,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS rank_height
    FROM Player
) ranked_players
WHERE rank_height = 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player
ORDER BY weight DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', birthday) AS INTEGER) > 34;

SELECT COUNT(M.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Player AS P
    ON M.home_player_1 = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p
  ON (   m.away_player_1  = p.player_api_id
      OR m.away_player_2  = p.player_api_id
      OR m.away_player_3  = p.player_api_id
      OR m.away_player_4  = p.player_api_id
      OR m.away_player_5  = p.player_api_id
      OR m.away_player_6  = p.player_api_id
      OR m.away_player_7  = p.player_api_id
      OR m.away_player_8  = p.player_api_id
      OR m.away_player_9  = p.player_api_id
      OR m.away_player_10 = p.player_api_id
      OR m.away_player_11 = p.player_api_id )
WHERE p.player_name = 'Daan Smith'
   OR p.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira';

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
FROM Match AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2
  ON T2.player_api_id IN (
      T1.home_player_1,  T1.home_player_2,  T1.home_player_3,
      T1.home_player_4,  T1.home_player_5,  T1.home_player_6,
      T1.home_player_7,  T1.home_player_8,  T1.home_player_9,
      T1.home_player_10, T1.home_player_11
  )
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', datetime(T2.birthday)) AS INTEGER) < 31;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (
    SELECT MAX(potential)
    FROM Player_Attributes
);

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa 
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.finishing = 1
GROUP BY T1.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime') - T1.birthday) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m
  ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,
        m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
     )
JOIN Country c
  ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P 
    ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match M 
    ON P.player_api_id IN (
        M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, 
        M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, 
        M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
        M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, 
        M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, 
        M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country C 
    ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name AS country_name,
       AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON m.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,
        m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
     )
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(P.height) AS average_height
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M 
    ON P.player_api_id = M.home_player_1
JOIN Country AS C 
    ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Italy';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Player
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(id)
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  );

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
                        WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 
                        THEN player_api_id 
                    END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS percentage_of_players
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT Country.name
FROM Country
JOIN League ON Country.id = League.country_id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT 
    M.home_team_goal,
    M.away_team_goal
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND M.date LIKE '2008-09-24%';

SELECT T1.sprint_speed, T1.agility, T1.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Alexis Blin'

SELECT Team_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team
JOIN Team_Attributes ON Team.team_api_id = Team_Attributes.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(m.match_api_id) AS num_games
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND l.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_team_score
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT T2.finishing, T2.curve
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT 
    L.name AS league_name,
    COUNT(M.id) AS total_games
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY total_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (
    SELECT MAX(away_team_goal)
    FROM Match
);

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.height < 180 AND PA.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
    / COUNT(PA.id) AS percentage
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT 
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        WHEN AVG(A13) > AVG(A12) THEN '1996'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c 
    ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_male_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id  = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female(s): smallest birth_date
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                      FROM client
                      WHERE gender = 'F')
  -- among those oldest females, keep the lowest average salary (A11)
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
               FROM client c2
               JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
               WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
                 AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                      FROM client
                                      WHERE gender = 'F'));

SELECT d.account_id
FROM disp AS d
JOIN client AS c
    ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.district_id = (
        -- district with the highest average salary (A11)
        SELECT district_id
        FROM district
        WHERE A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
      )
  AND c.birth_date = (
        -- youngest client (max birth_date) within that district
        SELECT MAX(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE district_id = (
              SELECT district_id
              FROM district
              WHERE A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
        )
      );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_owners
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.status = 'A'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) = '1997'
  AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY T2.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date LIKE '1993%'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_female_customers
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT account_id
FROM account
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
  AND date = (
      SELECT MIN(date)
      FROM account
      WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT disp.client_id
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date AS account_open_date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT A.district_id
FROM loan AS L
JOIN account AS A
  ON L.account_id = A.account_id
WHERE L.date = '1994-08-25'
  AND L.status = 'A';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount AS first_transaction_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
  AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_clients
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM disp d
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1996';

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name
FROM client c
JOIN disp   ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT T3.birth_date
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
WHERE T1.amount = 98832
  AND T1.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_client_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT
    ( (end_t.balance - start_t.balance) * 100.0
      / start_t.balance ) AS increase_rate
FROM trans AS start_t
JOIN trans AS end_t
    ON start_t.account_id = end_t.account_id
WHERE start_t.date = '1993-03-22'          -- Date B
  AND end_t.date   = '1998-12-27'          -- Date A
  AND start_t.account_id = (
        SELECT l.account_id
        FROM loan AS l
        WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
          AND l.status = 'C'                -- approved loan
        ORDER BY l.loan_id ASC              -- the first approved one
        LIMIT 1
      );

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 
        2
    ) AS pct_running_no_issue
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) = '1993';

SELECT DISTINCT
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp     AS d ON a.account_id   = d.account_id
JOIN client   AS c ON d.client_id    = c.client_id
JOIN district AS t ON c.district_id  = t.district_id
WHERE t.A3 = 'east Bohemia'                -- region of the client
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'                     -- the person who owns the account
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT 
    l.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT 
    loan.loan_id,
    district.A3 AS district_region,
    district.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.duration = 60;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp dsp ON c.client_id = dsp.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
  AND t.operation != 'VYBER KARTOU'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_holders_without_credit_cards
FROM client c
JOIN district d 
    ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND c.client_id NOT IN (
        SELECT dp.client_id
        FROM card cd
        JOIN disp dp 
            ON cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id
  );

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')   -- active loans: running contracts ('C' = OK, 'D' = in debt)
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT A2 AS branch_location,
       A2 AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district)
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trans.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND trans.balance < 0
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY CAST(A15 AS INTEGER) DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_total) AS avg_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
           SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)
) AS monthly_totals;

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'                 -- credit card withdrawal
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'              -- restrict to year 1998
  AND t.amount < (
        SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
        FROM trans t2
        WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'in-patients'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'outpatients'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS more_of,
    ROUND(
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 /
