SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND GPT > 30
  AND ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
  AND E.ANA = 'S'
  AND E.`aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
        FROM Examination
      );

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', `First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND Laboratory.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND Laboratory.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(L.ALB) AS average_albumin
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.PLT > 400
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F' 
  AND Diagnosis = 'APS';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory
WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '1997'
  AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT CAST(SUM(DIAGNOSIS LIKE '%ITP%') AS REAL) 
       / SUM(DIAGNOSIS LIKE '%SLE%') * 100 AS proportion
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET DISEASE'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(MIN(Examination."Examination Date")) 
            - JULIANDAY(Patient."First Date") AS INTEGER) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT CASE
         WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN l.UA > 8.0
         ELSE l.UA > 6.5
       END AS within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = '57266';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT < 60
  AND strftime('%Y', L.Date) = '1994';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.GPT >= 60;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GPT > 60
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC;

SELECT T1.ID,
       strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALP < 300;

SELECT P.ID,
       CASE 
           WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS "ALP within normal range"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TP < 6.0;

SELECT TP - 8.5
FROM Laboratory
WHERE TP > 8.5
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Patient
      WHERE SEX = 'F'
  );

SELECT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID, p.Birthday, l.Date, l.ALB,
       CASE
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS Is_ALB_Normal
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.UA > 6.5 THEN p.ID END) AS REAL) * 100.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS pct_female_abnormal_UA
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM (
    SELECT p.ID,
           p.SEX,
           l.UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
) AS T
WHERE T.rn = 1
  AND ((T.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
    OR (T.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5));

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS male_patients_abnormal_creatinine
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT (SUM(SEX = 'M') > SUM(SEX = 'F')) AS Result
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    L.`T-BIL` AS Highest_Bilirubin,
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) 
    FROM Laboratory
);

SELECT
    P.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(
        CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)
    ) AS REAL) / COUNT(P.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' 
  AND L."T-CHO" >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-'
  AND T2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.ID,
    T1.SEX,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS AGE
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU >= 180
  AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991'
  AND T2.GLU < 180;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5 OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY 
    P.SEX ASC,
    P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.Diagnosis, 
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND (strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) >= 50
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-'
  AND T2.HGB < 10;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.HGB > 10
  AND L.HGB < 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    T1.ID,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID
HAVING COUNT(T2.ID) > 2;

SELECT AVG(HCT) AS average_hematocrit
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date LIKE '1991%'
  AND HCT < 29;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_lower_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_higher_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', L.Date) = '1984'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 50
  AND L.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992'
  AND T2.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_examinations
FROM Examination
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND Laboratory.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.WBC > 3.5
  AND T2.WBC < 9.0
  AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (L.FG < 150 OR L.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND L.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE IGG > 900
        AND IGG < 2000
  );

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY L.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGA > 80
  AND T2.IGA < 500
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGM <= 40 OR L.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY P.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(P.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) >= '1985'
  AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RF < 20
  AND T2.Thrombosis = '0';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.C3 > 35
  AND Examination.[ANA Pattern] = 'P';

SELECT T2.ID
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.HCT <= 29 OR T1.HCT >= 52
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.RNP IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T1.Admission = '+'

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('negative', '0')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination E
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY T1.`First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T3.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID)
FROM Examination
JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.DNA >= 8;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.DNA < 8
  AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.GOT < 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) AS YoungestBirthday
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT < 60
ORDER BY T2.GPT DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT < 60
  AND P.SEX = 'M';

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS first_recorded_date
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH = (
    SELECT MAX(LDH)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH < 500
);

SELECT MAX(l.Date) AS Latest_Data_Date
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = (
        SELECT ID
        FROM Patient
        ORDER BY "First Date" DESC
        LIMIT 1
      )
  AND l.LDH >= 500;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS admitted_patient_count
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALP >= 300
  AND P.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.ALP < 300;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TP < 6.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND T2.TP > 6.0
  AND T2.TP < 8.5;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT
    E.`aCL IgG`,
    E.`aCL IgM`,
    E.`aCL IgA`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E
    ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'          -- female patient
  AND L.UA > 6.50          -- uric acid level in the normal range (per hint)
ORDER BY L.UA DESC         -- highest uric acid level (MAX)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS highest_ANA
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.ANA
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` < 2.0
ORDER BY T2.`T-BIL` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` >= 250
  AND E.KCT = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` < 250
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 0
  AND L.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CPK < 250
  AND (T1.KCT = '+' OR T1.RVVT = '+' OR T1.LAC = '+');

SELECT MIN(T1.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU > 180;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GLU < 180
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '+'
  AND Laboratory.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE (L.RBC <= 3.5 OR L.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.PLT > 100

WITH bond_elements AS (
    -- each bond paired with the elements of its two atoms
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           a1.element AS e1,
           a2.element AS e2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- number of bonds per element combination
    SELECT MIN(e1, e2) AS elem_a,   -- MIN/MAX normalizes (C,O) == (O,C)
           MAX(e1, e2) AS elem_b,
           COUNT(*)    AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY MIN(e1, e2), MAX(e1, e2)
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt), 2) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts;

    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
minTotals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AvgConsumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minTotals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS Percentage
    FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage
FROM pct
WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM pct)
   OR Percentage = (SELECT MIN(Percentage) FROM pct);

WITH target_account AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    ((SELECT balance FROM balance_end) - (SELECT balance FROM balance_start)) * 100.0
    / (SELECT balance FROM balance_start) AS increase_rate;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           MIN(a1.element, a2.element) || '-' || MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS combo
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE t.combo = (
    SELECT combo
    FROM (
        SELECT MIN(a1.element, a2.element) || '-' || MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS combo,
               COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM connected c
        JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        WHERE c.bond_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY combo
    )
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT
  -- SME annual average - LAM annual average
  (
    SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
    FROM customers AS T1
    JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME'
      AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  -
  (
    SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
    FROM customers AS T1
    JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
      AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS SME_minus_LAM,

  -- LAM annual average - KAM annual average
  (
    SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
    FROM customers AS T1
    JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
      AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  -
  (
    SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
    FROM customers AS T1
    JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS LAM_minus_KAM,

  -- KAM annual average - SME annual average
  (
    SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
    FROM customers AS T1
    JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  -
  (
    SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
    FROM customers AS T1
    JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME'
      AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT 
    C.Segment,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PctIncrease
FROM customers AS C
JOIN yearmonth AS Y 
    ON C.CustomerID = Y.CustomerID
WHERE C.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND SUBSTR(Y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY C.Segment
ORDER BY PctIncrease DESC;

JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT 
    (
        (SELECT PA.overall_rating
         FROM Player AS P
         JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
         WHERE P.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk')
        -
        (SELECT PA.overall_rating
         FROM Player AS P
         JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
         WHERE P.player_name = 'Paulin Puel')
    ) * 100.0
    /
    (SELECT PA.overall_rating
     FROM Player AS P
     JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
     WHERE P.player_name = 'Paulin Puel') AS percentage_higher;

SELECT 
    ( (LD.overall_rating - JB.overall_rating) * 100.0 / LD.overall_rating ) AS percentage
FROM
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player p
     JOIN Player_Attributes pa 
          ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
       AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') AS LD,
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player p
     JOIN Player_Attributes pa 
          ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
       AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') AS JB;

        M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
        M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
        M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country AS C
    ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT C.name
FROM Country C
JOIN (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) AS appearances
    ON C.id = appearances.country_id
JOIN Player P
    ON P.player_api_id = appearances.player_api_id
GROUP BY C.name
HAVING AVG(P.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_w)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(P2.weight) AS avg_w
        FROM Country C2
        JOIN (
            SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
        ) AS app2 ON C2.id = app2.country_id
        JOIN Player P2 ON P2.player_api_id = app2.player_api_id
        GROUP BY C2.name
    ) AS t
);

    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM italian_match

    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM italian_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM italian_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM italian_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM italian_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM italian_match

    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM italian_match

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp     ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id     = disp.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female clients
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                      FROM client
                      WHERE gender = 'F')
  -- living in the district with the lowest average salary among them
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
               FROM district d2
               JOIN client c2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
               WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
                 AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                      FROM client
                                      WHERE gender = 'F'));

JOIN disp AS d     ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c   ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN district AS t ON a.district_id = t.district_id

WITH target_account AS (                 -- Step 1: client's loan approved on 1993-07-05
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_b AS (                           -- Step 2: balance on 1993-03-22 (start)
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_a AS (                           -- Step 3: balance on 1998-12-27 (end)
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account)
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

       AS increase_rate_percent          -- Step 4: increase rate

INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CRE < 1.5
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T2.`aCL IgA`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT ANA
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `T-BIL` < 2.0
    ORDER BY `T-BIL` DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-CHO` >= 250 AND T3.KCT = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-CHO` < 250
  AND Examination.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.TG < 200 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 0
  AND T3.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CPK < 250
  AND (T2.KCT = '+' OR T2.RVVT = '+' OR T2.LAC = '+')

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU > 180
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.GLU < 180
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Admission = '+' 
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.PLT > 100
  AND T2.PLT < 400
  AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;

SELECT Laboratory.PLT
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND Laboratory.PLT > 100
  AND Laboratory.PLT < 400;

SELECT AVG(T1.PT) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.PT < 14

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) 
FROM Examination E 
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID 
WHERE E.Thrombosis IN (1, 2) 
  AND L.PT < 14;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT AVG(element = 'o') AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE label = '-' 
  AND molecule_id IN (
      SELECT molecule_id 
      FROM atom 
      WHERE element = 'na'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '=';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
  AND label = '+';

SELECT a1.element AS element_1, a2.element AS element_2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T1.label
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'h'
GROUP BY T1.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T3.bond_type
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'cl'

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.element
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.element) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.bond_type
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE (T1.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (T1.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8')

SELECT DISTINCT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'sn'
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element IN ('i', 's')
  AND bond.bond_type = '-'

SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR181'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR181';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN atom.molecule_id END) * 100
     / COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '#') * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR001'
  AND bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6';

SELECT bond_id
FROM connected
WHERE atom_id2 = (
    SELECT atom_id2
    FROM connected
    WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2'
);

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
ORDER BY m.label ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT a.element, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR060';

SELECT b.bond_type, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM bond 
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id 
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR009' 
  AND (connected.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR connected.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'br';

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT T1.molecule_id, T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25';

SELECT T1.bond_id 
FROM connected AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id 
JOIN atom AS T4 ON T3.atom_id2 = T4.atom_id 
WHERE T2.element = 'p' AND T4.element = 'n'

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top ON m.molecule_id = top.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id) AS avg_bonds
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'i';

SELECT T2.bond_type, T1.bond_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 2) + 0 = 45;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id  FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

WITH bond_elements AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id, a1.element AS elem1, a2.element AS elem2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT elem1, elem2, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
)
SELECT 100.0 * cnt / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts
WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM combo_counts);

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 
        5
    ) AS carcinogenic_single_bond_pct
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 's';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'sn';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element)
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (

    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
      AND a.element IN ('p', 'br')
);

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '+'
  AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR030';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'i';

SELECT MAX(molecule.label)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'ca';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element) = 2 
         THEN 1 
         ELSE 0 
       END AS has_both_cl_and_c
FROM connected AS C
JOIN atom AS T1 ON C.atom_id  = T1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T2 ON C.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
WHERE C.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND T1.element = 'cl'
  AND T2.element = 'c';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
  AND T3.bond_type = '#'
  AND T2.element = 'c'
LIMIT 2

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(atom.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT A1.element, A2.element
FROM connected AS C

    ON C.atom_id = A1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS A2 
    ON C.atom_id2 = A2.atom_id
WHERE C.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN bond AS T2 
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' 
  AND T1.label = '-';

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element) AS hydrogen_ratio,
    m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.bond_type
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'c';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

                      FROM bond

SELECT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = 'TR151'
  AND atom.element IN ('cl', 'br');

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.molecule_id, T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c'
  AND substr(T2.molecule_id, 3, 3) >= 10
  AND substr(T2.molecule_id, 3, 3) <= 50;

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1

SELECT T2.bond_type
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id

JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.element

    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c 
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'

FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT COUNT(*)

JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

  AND b.bond_type != '=';

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id

        / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+' AND T2.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR024';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T3.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T3.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2   ON T1.atom_id  = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T4   ON T1.atom_id2 = T4.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T5   ON T1.bond_id  = T5.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T5.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'h'
  AND T4.element = 'h'
  AND T5.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = 'TR008'
  AND T1.element = 'c';

SELECT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR004_7' 
  AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.atom_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 
    ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 
    ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T1.label = 'TR012' 
  AND T2.element = 'c' 
  AND T4.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT
    /* SME annual average - LAM annual average */
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'SME'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1)
  -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_SME_LAM,

    /* LAM annual average - KAM annual average */
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1)
  -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_LAM_KAM,

    /* KAM annual average - SME annual average */
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1)
  -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'SME'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Total_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Total_2013,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END))
        * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END),
        2
    ) AS Pct_Increase
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT c.name AS country
FROM Country c
JOIN match_players mp ON mp.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p         ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(p.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_weight)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(p2.weight) AS avg_weight
        FROM Country c2
        JOIN match_players mp2 ON mp2.country_id = c2.id
        JOIN Player p2         ON p2.player_api_id = mp2.player_api_id
        GROUP BY c2.name
    ) t
);

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 
    ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.status = 'C'                          -- approved loan
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) = '1997'         -- loan date in 1997
  AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'          -- weekly issuance statement
  AND T2.amount = (
        SELECT MIN(T3.amount)
        FROM loan AS T3
        WHERE T3.status = 'C'
          AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3.date) = '1997'
  );

SELECT a.account_id, l.amount
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12          -- loan validity more than 12 months
  AND l.status = 'A'           -- approved loans
  AND a.date LIKE '1993%'      -- account opened in 1993
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND di.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
  AND date = (SELECT MIN(date)
              FROM trans
              WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995');

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date AS account_opening_date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25'
  AND loan.status = 'A';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d  ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A11 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount AS first_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.account_id = (
        SELECT l.account_id
        FROM loan l
        ORDER BY l.amount DESC
        LIMIT 1
      )
  AND t.date >= a.date          -- transaction must occur after account opening
ORDER BY t.date, t.trans_id     -- earliest transaction first
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_clients
FROM client c
JOIN disp d     ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a  ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 2) = '96';

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND d.A4 = (
      SELECT MAX(A4)
      FROM district
      WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  );

SELECT
    (t_end.balance - t_start.balance) * 100.0 / t_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM trans t_start
JOIN trans t_end
    ON t_start.account_id = t_end.account_id
WHERE t_start.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND t_end.date   = '1998-12-27'
  AND t_start.account_id = (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM loan
        WHERE date = '1993-07-05'      -- the first approved loan
        ORDER BY loan_id
        LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) 
    AS pct_loan_amount_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / SUM(amount), 
    2) AS percentage_running_ok
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND a.date LIKE '93%';

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp 
    ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c 
    ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    d.A3 AS district,
    d.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.district_id,
    ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id  = l.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 
        2
    ) AS decin_percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT d.A2 AS district,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS account_holders_without_card
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE dist.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM card cd
      WHERE cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
  );

SELECT D.A3 AS district_name
FROM district D
JOIN account A ON D.district_id = A.district_id
JOIN loan L ON A.account_id = L.account_id
WHERE L.status IN ('C', 'D')          -- active/running contracts only
GROUP BY D.A3
ORDER BY SUM(L.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT 
    a.district_id AS branch_location,
    d.A2          AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN account a 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans t
INNER JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
AND l.status = 'A';                       -- approved loans

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.district_id = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND t.date BETWEEN 970101 AND 971231;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN "order" o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_amount) AS avg_credit_card_amount_per_month
FROM (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%m', t.date) AS month,
        SUM(t.amount) AS monthly_amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY strftime('%m', t.date)
) AS monthly_totals;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'          -- credit card withdrawal
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'       -- SQLite-compatible year extraction
  AND t.amount < (SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
                  FROM trans t2
                  WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
                    AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1998');

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp  d  ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN card  cd ON cd.disp_id   = d.disp_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN loan  l  ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND di.A3 = 'south Bohemia';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT d.type AS account_type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND di.A11 > 8000
  AND di.A11 <= 9000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district_name
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ';

SELECT AVG(d.A15) AS avg_crimes_1995
FROM district d
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
  AND d.district_id IN (
      SELECT a.district_id
      FROM account a
      WHERE a.date >= '1997-01-01'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS classic_cards_eligible_for_loan
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'classic'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients_praha
FROM client c

WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';

SELECT cl.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date

JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.A15
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.account_id = 532;

SELECT account.district_id

JOIN account ON "order".account_id = account.account_id
WHERE "order".order_id = 33333;

SELECT t.trans_id,
       t.account_id,
       t.date,
       t.type,
       t.operation,
       t.amount,
       t.balance,
       t.k_symbol,
       t.bank,
       t.account
FROM trans t

  AND t.operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount < 200000;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3 AS region
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 
    a.district_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY num_accounts DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.client_id,
       c.gender,
       c.birth_date,
       c.district_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN disp   d ON o.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
WHERE o.order_id = 32423;

SELECT t.trans_id,
       t.account_id,
       t.date,
       t.type,
       t.operation,
       t.amount,
       t.balance,
       t.k_symbol,
       t.bank,
       t.account
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 5;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik';

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'junior'
  AND c.issued >= '1997-01-01';

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) 
        / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 
    2) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d       ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account a    ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district di  ON di.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     -
     SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
        SELECT d.account_id
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
        WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      )
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS credit_card_withdrawals
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND date > '1995-12-31';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district
WHERE A3 IN ('north Bohemia', 'east Bohemia');

SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM disp
WHERE account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
GROUP BY type;

SELECT
    a.frequency,   -- how often the account statement is released
    t.k_symbol     -- purpose/aim of the debit
FROM account a
JOIN trans t
    ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 3
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'      -- 'VYDAJ' = debit (withdrawal) in this dataset
  AND t.amount = 3539;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT

JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id

SELECT t.balance AS balance_after_trans_851,

JOIN disp  d ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 4
  AND t.trans_id = 851;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 9;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1999-01-01';

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.client_id,
    c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a
    ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di
    ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1983 AND 1987
  AND di.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND t.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND t.amount > 4000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND a.date >= '1997-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_junior_card_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d  ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND cd.type = 'junior';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(c.client_id) AS pct_female
FROM client c
JOIN disp d     ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a  ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district t ON a.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE t.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS male_weekly_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 24
  AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
ORDER BY l.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T3.account_id
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 
    ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN account AS T3 
    ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN district AS T4 
    ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY T1.birth_date ASC, T4.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) = '1920'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_accounts
FROM loan

WHERE loan.duration = 24

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT c.client_id,
       d.A2 AS district
FROM client c
JOIN disp    dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district d  ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT c.client_id,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INT) 
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INT) AS age
FROM client c

JOIN income i     ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id

HAVING COUNT(i.income_id) > 40;

JOIN budget B  ON E.link_to_budget = B.budget_id
GROUP BY M.member_id, M.first_name, M.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT B.link_to_event) > 1
ORDER BY total_paid DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
INNER JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id

INNER JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id

GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING SUM(x.cost) / COUNT(e.event_id) < (
    SELECT SUM(x2.cost) / COUNT(e2.event_id)
    FROM event AS e2
    JOIN budget AS b2 ON e2.event_id = b2.link_to_event
    JOIN expense AS x2 ON b2.budget_id = x2.link_to_budget
    WHERE b2.category = 'Parking'
);
