JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT superpower.power_name
FROM hero_power
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE hero_power.hero_id = 56;

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE race.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(T1.id)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.weight_kg = 169;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg = (SELECT MAX(weight_kg) FROM superhero);

SELECT SUM(publisher.id = 13) * 100.0 / COUNT(publisher.id) AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.gender = 'Male'
  AND T1.weight_kg > (SELECT AVG(weight_kg) * 0.79 FROM superhero);

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superpower AS sp
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
GROUP BY sp.power_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM hero_power AS T1
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.hero_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.hero_id) AS hero_count
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'stealth';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(id) * 1.0 / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'durability'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Abraham Sapien';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Flight';

SELECT c1.colour AS eye_colour, 
       c2.colour AS hair_colour, 
       c3.colour AS skin_colour
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN colour c1 ON superhero.eye_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON superhero.hair_colour_id = c2.id
JOIN colour c3 ON superhero.skin_colour_id = c3.id
WHERE gender.gender = 'Female' 
  AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.hair_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id 
  AND s.hair_colour_id = s.eye_colour_id;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'A-Bomb';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT gender.gender
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Agent 13';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Adaptation';

SELECT COUNT(hero_power.power_id) AS num_powers
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Amazo';

SELECT superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON superpower.id = hero_power.power_id
WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Hunter Zolomon';

SELECT T1.height_cm
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.eye_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.hair_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Black'
  AND c2.colour = 'Black';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.colour
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T2.id
JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT T1.superhero_name 
FROM superhero AS T1 
JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.alignment = 'Neutral'

SELECT COUNT(T1.hero_id) 
FROM hero_attribute AS T1
INNER JOIN attribute AS T2 ON T1.attribute_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND T1.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(T3.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS T3
      INNER JOIN attribute AS T4 ON T3.attribute_id = T4.id
      WHERE T4.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  );

SELECT race.race, alignment.alignment
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Cameron Hicks';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT AVG(weight_kg) 
FROM superhero 
INNER JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id 
WHERE race.race = 'Alien';

SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') 
     - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS difference;

SELECT 
    superhero_name,
    SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(id) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name;

SELECT superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.superhero_name IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy');

SELECT SUM(gender_id = 1) / SUM(gender_id = 2) AS ratio
FROM superhero;
SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'cryokinesis';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Helen Parr';

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg = 108
  AND superhero.height_cm = 188;

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE hero_attribute.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS average_attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.alignment_id = 3;

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
FROM colour AS c
INNER JOIN superhero AS s ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
WHERE alignment_id = 1 
  AND gender_id = 2;

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' 
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE gender.gender = 'Female'
  AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT g.gender
FROM superpower sp
JOIN hero_power hp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
JOIN superhero s ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg = (
      SELECT MAX(s2.weight_kg)
      FROM superhero s2
      JOIN publisher p2 ON s2.publisher_id = p2.id
      WHERE p2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  );

SELECT AVG(height_cm)
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE race.race <> 'Human'
  AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT 
    SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS difference
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT a.attribute_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM superhero s2
      JOIN hero_attribute ha2 ON s2.id = ha2.hero_id
      WHERE s2.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
  );

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(superhero.id) AS percentage_female_superheroes
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100 AND T2.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT hero_attribute.attribute_value
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT colour.colour 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id 
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
            SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Birthday) > '1930' THEN ID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) 
    / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.ID = '30609'

SELECT 
    T1.SEX, 
    T1.Birthday, 
    T2.`Examination Date`, 
    T2.Symptoms 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH > 500;

SELECT T1.ID, 
       CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND T2.`T-CHO` >= '250';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN L.TP < '6.0' OR L.TP > '8.5' THEN L.ID END) AS REAL) * 100 
       / COUNT(P.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997'
  AND Admission = '-'

SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', `First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS Age
FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200;

SELECT T1.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T2.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) / 12
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M'

SELECT L.Date,
       (strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS Age_At_Arrival
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
  /
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS underage_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age,
    E.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT ANA 
FROM Examination 
WHERE ID = 3605340 
  AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE ID = 2927464 
  AND Date = '1995-09-04' 
  AND "T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY "First Date" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GPT = '9' AND L.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) - SUBSTR(T2.Birthday, 1, 4) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(T2.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T1.`First Date` = (SELECT MIN(`First Date`) 
                         FROM Patient 
                         WHERE ID = T1.ID);

SELECT E.Symptoms
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-03-01'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993-09-27';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Laboratory.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN Laboratory.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) 
     - SUM(CASE WHEN Laboratory.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN Laboratory.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T2."Examination Date" >= '1997-01-01'
  AND T2."Examination Date" < '1998-01-01';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND T2.GPT > 30
  AND T2.ALB < 4;

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT SUM(Patient.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET') * 100.0 / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' 
  AND strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E."ANA Pattern" != 'P'
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP = 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(T1.ALB)

SELECT
  -- Difference: SME - LAM
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'SME'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'LAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS diff_SME_LAM,

  -- Difference: LAM - KAM
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'LAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS diff_LAM_KAM,

  -- Difference: KAM - SME
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'SME'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH EUR_Yearly AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
Pct AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (Cons_2013 - Cons_2012) * 100.0 / Cons_2013 AS Percentage_Increase
    FROM EUR_Yearly
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase
FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase
      FROM Pct
      ORDER BY Percentage_Increase DESC
      LIMIT 1) AS Biggest
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase
FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase
      FROM Pct
      ORDER BY Percentage_Increase ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS Lowest;

FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', Player.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT (
    (SELECT overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes
     WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id 
                            FROM Player 
                            WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk')
     ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)
    -
    (SELECT overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes
     WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id 
                            FROM Player 
                            WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel')
     ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)
) * 100.0 /
    (SELECT overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes
     WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id 
                            FROM Player 
                            WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel')
     ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)
AS percentage_higher;

WITH bm AS (
    -- restrict to matches played in Belgium first (small set)
    SELECT home_player_1,  home_player_2,  home_player_3,  home_player_4,
           home_player_5,  home_player_6,  home_player_7,  home_player_8,
           home_player_9,  home_player_10, home_player_11,
           away_player_1,  away_player_2,  away_player_3,  away_player_4,
           away_player_5,  away_player_6,  away_player_7,  away_player_8,
           away_player_9,  away_player_10, away_player_11
    FROM Match
    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Belgium')
),
pids AS (
    -- collect all player IDs from those matches (UNION removes duplicates)
    SELECT home_player_1 AS pid FROM bm
    UNION SELECT home_player_2  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT home_player_4  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM bm
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM bm
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT away_player_5  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT away_player_6  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT away_player_7  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT away_player_8  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT away_player_9  FROM bm
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM bm
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM bm
)
SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN pids ON P.player_api_id = pids.pid
WHERE P.player_name IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P 
    ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M 
    ON  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_1
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_2
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_3
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_4
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_5
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_6
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_7
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_8
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_9
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_10
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_11
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_1
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_2
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_3
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_4
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_5
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_6
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_7
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_8
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_9
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_10
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_11
JOIN Country AS C 
    ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM (
    SELECT mp.country_id, AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
    FROM (
        SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
    ) AS mp
    JOIN Player AS p
        ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
    GROUP BY mp.country_id
) AS t
JOIN Country AS c
    ON c.id = t.country_id
ORDER BY t.avg_weight DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) AS num_eligible_accounts
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2
    ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T2.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND T2.A11 > (SELECT AVG(A11) FROM district);

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' 
         ELSE '1996' 
       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    d.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - dis.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp d     ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) 
                      FROM client 
                      WHERE gender = 'F')
ORDER BY dis.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T3.account_id
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T1.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND T4.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT client.client_id
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND disp.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT account_id
FROM account
WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND account_id IN (
      SELECT account_id
      FROM loan
      WHERE status = 'C'
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1997'
        AND amount = (
            SELECT MIN(amount)
            FROM loan
            WHERE status = 'C'
              AND STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1997'
        )
  );

JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'

JOIN disp AS T2

SELECT

  AND T2.date = '1993-03-22'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT

    d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT DISTINCT

    T1.frequency
FROM account AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 
    ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T2.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) BETWEEN '1995' AND '2000';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account

WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT 
    l.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT loan.loan_id, district.A3, district.A11
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.duration = 60;

SELECT d.A2 AS district,
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a  ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c   ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM district d
JOIN client c 
    ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp 
    ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, 
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_holders_without_card
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM disp dp
        JOIN card c 
            ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
        WHERE dp.account_id = a.account_id
  );

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name, l.amount AS active_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT A3 AS branch_location, 
       A2 AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_male_clients
FROM client c

      SELECT d.district_id
      FROM district d
      WHERE d.A15 = (
          SELECT DISTINCT d2.A15
          FROM district d2

          LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
      )
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account

WHERE card.type = 'gold';

SELECT STRFTIME('%m', date) AS month,
       AVG(amount)          AS avg_credit_card_amount
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '2021'

ORDER BY month;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'                 -- credit card withdrawal

        WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
          AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1998'     -- average credit card amount in 1998
  );

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_women
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
    WHERE dt.A11 > 10000
) t;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     -
     SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    * 100.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS credit_card_withdrawals

WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

    (SELECT SUM(A16)

    (SELECT SUM(A16)

     WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference;

       t.k_symbol  AS debit_purpose

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) AS num_accounts

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid (debt)'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running contract - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running contract - client IN DEBT'

SELECT SUM(T3.balance), T1.gender

JOIN trans AS T3 
    ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id

SELECT card.type

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid

JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617

  AND substr(t.date, 1, 4) = '1998';

SELECT DISTINCT 
       c.client_id, 
       c.birth_date

JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = a.district_id

SELECT client.client_id
FROM client

WHERE client.gender = 'F'

LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts

WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_junior_card

JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id

SELECT

JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT

JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

        SELECT MIN(amount)

SELECT a.account_id

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)

JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T2.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT p.*
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND l.`T-CHO` >= '250';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT
    CAST(
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN P.SEX = 'F'
                     AND (CAST(L.TP AS REAL) < 6.0 OR CAST(L.TP AS REAL) > 8.5)
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS REAL
    ) * 100 / COUNT(P.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(T1.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Admission = '+'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50;

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997'
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT E.Symptoms, E.Diagnosis
FROM Examination E
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = (
        SELECT MAX(P2.Birthday)
        FROM Patient P2
        JOIN Examination E2 ON P2.ID = E2.ID
      )
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS REAL) / 12 AS avg_male_patients_per_month
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT L.`Date`                                                 AS lab_date,
       strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age_at_first_arrival
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
     ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'        -- SJS patient
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC          -- oldest patient = smallest birthday
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P
    ON L.ID = P.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e 
    ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS underage_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age,
    T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 
    ON T3.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T3.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT ANA
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = 3605340
  AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT COUNT("T-CHO") 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE ID = 2927464 
  AND Date = '1995-9-4' 
  AND "T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY `First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', L.Date) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4'
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) AS Total_Laboratory_Tests
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1995';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT T1.Symptoms
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Birthday = '1959/3/1'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993/9/27';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.`Date` LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN l.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) 
    - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.`Date` LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN l.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) 
    AS decrease_rate
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p 
    ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T2."Examination Date" >= '1997-1-1'
  AND T2."Examination Date" < '1998-1-1';

SELECT DISTINCT ID
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND GPT > 30
  AND ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(ID), ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+'
GROUP BY ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
WHERE `U-PRO` > 0 AND `U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND Laboratory.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND Laboratory.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P' 
  AND T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989';

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(T2.ALB)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T2.PLT > 400
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', L.Date) = '1997'
  AND (L.TP <= 6 OR L.TP >= 8.5);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
     / SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND Examination.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T2.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(T2.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = 821298;

SELECT L.ID, L.Date, L.UA, P.SEX
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.ID = 57266
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA > 8.0)
    OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA > 6.5));

SELECT Laboratory.Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Laboratory.ID = '48473'
  AND Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1994'
  AND T2.GOT < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GPT > 60
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, 
       (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT Patient.Admission
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALP < 300;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE 
           WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TP < 6.0;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T2.Date, 
    T2.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Out of normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN L.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory AS T
JOIN Patient AS P
    ON T.ID = P.ID
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) AS Latest
    ON T.ID = Latest.ID
   AND T.Date = Latest.latest_date
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5);

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
ORDER BY T2.`T-BIL` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    P.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`)
    FROM Laboratory
)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
           - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
       / COUNT(ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE `T-CHO` >= 250
  );

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200
  AND (strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.ID,
    T1.SEX,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU >= 180 
  AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991'
  AND T2.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.WBC <= 3.5 OR T2.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY T1.SEX ASC, T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.Diagnosis, 
    (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, l.RBC, p.Admission
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
  AND (CAST(l.RBC AS REAL) <= 3.5 OR CAST(l.RBC AS REAL) >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.HGB < 10;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.HGB > 10
  AND T2.HGB < 17
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.ID,
       strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY P.ID, P.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(L.ID) > 2;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50
  AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.PT >= 14 AND T2.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992'
  AND T2.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' 
  AND T2.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.WBC > 3.5
  AND T2.WBC < 9.0
  AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` >= 30
);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID)
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900
  AND L.IGG < 2000
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGA = (
    SELECT MAX(IGA)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.IGA > 80 
  AND Laboratory.IGA < 500 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGM <= 40 OR T2.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) >= '1985' 
  AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(L.RF AS REAL) < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = '0';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.C3 > 35 AND T3.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT <= 29 OR T2.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T1.`aCL IgA`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS' 
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND P.ID NOT IN (
      SELECT E.ID
      FROM Examination E
      WHERE E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY T1.`First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c'
  AND substr(T2.molecule_id, 3, 3) >= 10
  AND substr(T2.molecule_id, 3, 3) <= 50;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = ' = '
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'h'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' AND T2.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds,
    m.label          AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id, 
    c.atom_id, 
    c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
);

SELECT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3'
UNION
SELECT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule  m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond      b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS molecules_with_double_bond,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_with_double_bond
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T1.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'cl'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
    / COUNT(atom.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) AS num_elements
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id IN (
        SELECT atom_id
        FROM connected
        WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'
        UNION
        SELECT atom_id2
        FROM connected
        WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'
      );

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
  AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_2';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's'
  AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
  AND m.label = 'TR024';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(m.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a1.element = 'h'
  AND a2.element = 'h'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS num_molecules
FROM bond b
WHERE b.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = 'TR008' AND T1.element = 'c';

SELECT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR004_7'
  AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 
    ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 
    ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 'o'
  AND T4.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'o';

SELECT
    frpm.`School Name`,
    frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools
    ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation High School'
  AND frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT schools.MailStreet
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
INNER JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND frpm.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly Funded'

SELECT COUNT(T1.School)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds

SELECT T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM satscores s

WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND sc.FundingType = 'Directly Funded';

SELECT T2.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT MAX(
    CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds

SELECT s.Phone

JOIN schools AS s
    ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode

SELECT

    s.School,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC

SELECT

FROM satscores sat

    ON sat.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.StatusType = 'Active'

SELECT COUNT(T2.School)

  AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged'

SELECT

    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) AS num_schools
FROM satscores AS T1

WHERE T2.`County Name` = 'Fresno'

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools

SELECT sname
FROM satscores

SELECT 
    T1.`School Name`,
    T2.Street,
    T2.City,
    T2.State,
    T2.Zip

JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30;

SELECT sc.School
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS sa ON f.CDSCode = sa.cds
JOIN schools AS sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1

SELECT s.sname AS School, sc.FundingType
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.sname
HAVING AVG(s.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip

    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'

  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT
    s.sname,
    AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score,
    sc.Phone

    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode

SELECT s.School,
       s.DOCType

        FROM frpm AS f2
        INNER JOIN schools AS s2

        WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM schools AS s

SELECT

FROM frpm AS f

    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

SELECT T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate

SELECT

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_closures

WITH cust_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (only those paying in CZK)
    SELECT c.Segment,
           c.CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    -- Minimum (least) total consumption per segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS lowest_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average of the lowest-consuming customers per segment
    -- = total consumption of those customers / number of those customers
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN lowest l
      ON l.Segment = ct.Segment
     AND l.lowest_consumption = ct.total_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH eur_consumption AS (
    -- Total consumption per segment per year, only for EUR-paying customers
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption)   AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
segment_totals AS (
    -- Pivot yearly sums into one row per segment
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM eur_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
pct_change AS (
    -- Percentage of increase = (2013 consumption - 2012 consumption) / 2013 consumption * 100
    SELECT
        Segment,
        ROUND((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013, 2) AS percentage_increase
    FROM segment_totals
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct_change ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct_change ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC  LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment;

    SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
),
country_players AS (
    -- Keep each player only once per country so repeated appearances don't skew the average
    SELECT DISTINCT country_id, player_api_id
    FROM match_players
)

           M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
           M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
           M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
           M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
           M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    FROM Match M
    JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
    WHERE C.name = 'Italy'
),
ItalianPlayerIds AS (
    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_id FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM ItalianMatches
)

WITH target_client AS (
    -- Find the loan approved (status = 'C') on 1993-07-05, take the first one,
    -- and get the client & account linked to it
    SELECT d.client_id, l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
      AND l.status = 'C'          -- 'C' = running/approved contract
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    -- Account balance on 1993-03-22
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_client tc ON t.account_id = tc.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    -- Account balance on 1998-12-27
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_client tc ON t.account_id = tc.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (balance_end.balance - balance_start.balance) * 100.0
       / balance_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end;

),
yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.date LIKE '96%' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_1996,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.date LIKE '97%' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_1997
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_accounts ma ON ma.account_id = l.account_id
