WITH annual_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK customer, grouped by segment
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
        ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM annual_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- The customer(s) with the least consumption in each segment
    SELECT
        a.Segment,
        a.total_consumption
    FROM annual_totals a
    JOIN segment_min m
        ON a.Segment = m.Segment
       AND a.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of lowest customers / count of those customers
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013 AS percentage_increase
    FROM consumption
)
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM pct
WHERE percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM pct)
   OR percentage_increase = (SELECT MIN(percentage_increase) FROM pct);

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'   -- first 4 chars of Date = year 2013
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,

    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,

    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH cons AS (
    -- Total consumption per segment per year, for EUR-paying customers only
    SELECT c.Segment AS segment,
           SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS year,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c
         ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
pct AS (
    -- Percentage change = (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2013 * 100
    SELECT segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
          / SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN consumption END) AS pct_change
    FROM cons
    GROUP BY segment
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) <> 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) <> 0
)
SELECT (SELECT segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_change DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase,
       (SELECT segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_change ASC  LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase;

    / SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN yearmonth AS y 
    ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE t.Price = 634.8
  AND t.Date = '2012-08-25';

    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match

    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match

WITH oldest_female AS (              -- Step 1: oldest female client(s)
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                        FROM client
                        WHERE gender = 'F')
),
lowest_salary AS (                   -- Step 2: lowest avg salary (A11) among them
    SELECT MIN(dt.A11) AS min_a11
    FROM oldest_female o
    JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = o.district_id
)
SELECT a.account_id                                     AS account_number,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - ls.min_a11     AS gap
FROM oldest_female o
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = o.district_id
JOIN disp     dp ON dp.client_id   = o.client_id
JOIN account  a  ON a.account_id   = dp.account_id
CROSS JOIN lowest_salary ls
WHERE dt.A11 = ls.min_a11;

WITH approved_loan AS (
    -- The loan that was approved (status 'A' or 'C') on 1993-07-05
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE status IN ('A', 'C')
      AND date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    -- Account balance on 1993-03-22
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM approved_loan)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    -- Account balance on 1998-12-27
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM approved_loan)
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (balance_end.balance - balance_start.balance) * 100.0
       / balance_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end;

SELECT

SELECT 
    p.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT L.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (
    SELECT MAX("T-CHO")
    FROM Laboratory
)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Birthday)) / COUNT(P.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L."T-CHO" >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND Laboratory.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT
    Patient.ID,
    Patient.SEX,
    strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GLU >= 180
  AND Laboratory."T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT L.ID, L.GLU
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.GLU < 180
  AND strftime('%Y', P.Description) = '1991';

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5
   OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.Diagnosis, 
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) >= 50
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

  AND L.HGB < 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID
HAVING COUNT(T2.ID) > 2;

SELECT AVG(HCT) 
FROM Laboratory

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
   FROM Laboratory
   WHERE PLT < 100)
  -
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
   FROM Laboratory
   WHERE PLT > 400) AS low_minus_high;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', L.Date) = '1984'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 50
  AND L.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.PT >= 14 AND T2.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992'
  AND T2.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Examination AS E

WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.WBC > 3.5
  AND T2.WBC < 9.0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient P

JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient

    SELECT ID

    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGA > 80
  AND T2.IGA < 500
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient

       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.RF < 20

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

WHERE T2.C3 > 35

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1

JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.HCT <= 29 OR T2.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T3.`aCL IgA`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID

FROM Patient p

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID

SELECT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P

WHERE L.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

       (SELECT COUNT(ID) 
        FROM Laboratory 
        WHERE GOT >= 60) AS percentage

WHERE GOT >= 60

             FROM Patient

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1

    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.LDH < 500          -- LDH within the normal range
    ORDER BY L.LDH DESC        -- highest LDH first
    LIMIT 1                    -- patient with the highest normal-range LDH

FROM Laboratory AS L
WHERE L.ID = (
        SELECT P.ID
        FROM Patient AS P
        WHERE P.ID IN (
                SELECT DISTINCT ID

                WHERE LDH >= 500

        LIMIT 1
      );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

  AND T2.ALB < 5.5

SELECT T1.Diagnosis

SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.ID

SELECT DISTINCT
       CASE a1.element
            WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'   WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
            WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'   WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
            WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'     WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
            WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus' WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
            WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'    WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
            WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'     WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
            WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'       WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
            WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
            ELSE a1.element
       END AS element_atom1,
       CASE a2.element
            WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'   WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
            WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'   WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
            WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'     WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
            WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus' WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
            WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'    WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
            WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'     WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
            WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'       WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
            WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
            ELSE a2.element
       END AS element_atom2
FROM   connected c
JOIN   atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN   atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE  c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

WITH annual_consumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (only CZK-paying customers)
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_by_segment AS (
    -- Lowest annual consumption in each segment (SME, LAM, KAM)
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM annual_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- Customers with the lowest consumption per segment:
    -- annual average = total consumption per year / number of such customers
    SELECT a.Segment,
           SUM(a.total_consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM annual_consumption a
    JOIN min_by_segment m
      ON m.Segment = a.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = a.total_consumption
    GROUP BY a.Segment
),
avg_by_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

     - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) AS `Increase or Decrease`,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END))
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS `Percentage of Increase`
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c
    ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND (SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' OR SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY `Percentage of Increase` DESC;

WITH annual_consumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (only CZK-paying customers)
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_by_segment AS (
    -- Lowest annual consumption in each segment (SME, LAM, KAM)
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM annual_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- Customers with the lowest consumption per segment:
    -- annual average = total consumption per year / number of such customers
    SELECT a.Segment,
           SUM(a.total_consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM annual_consumption a
    JOIN min_by_segment m
      ON m.Segment = a.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = a.total_consumption
    GROUP BY a.Segment
),
avg_by_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH unit_prices AS (
    -- Unit price paid in every transaction
    SELECT
        GasStationID,
        Price * 1.0 / NULLIF(Amount, 0) AS unit_price
    FROM transactions_1k
),
station_avg AS (
    -- Average unit price per gas station
    SELECT
        GasStationID,
        AVG(unit_price) AS avg_station_price
    FROM unit_prices
    GROUP BY GasStationID
),
overall_avg AS (
    -- Overall average unit price across all transactions
    SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS avg_all_price
    FROM unit_prices
),
value_for_money AS (
    -- Stations cheaper than the overall average
    SELECT s.GasStationID, g.Country
    FROM station_avg s
    JOIN gasstations g
      ON g.GasStationID = s.GasStationID
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
    WHERE s.avg_station_price < o.avg_all_price
)
SELECT
    Country,
    COUNT(*) AS value_for_money_stations
FROM value_for_money
GROUP BY Country
ORDER BY value_for_money_stations DESC;

FROM major
JOIN member ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business'

SELECT T2.type 
FROM member AS T1 
JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code 
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Christof' 
  AND T1.last_name = 'Nielson';

SELECT T1.major_name
FROM major AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major
WHERE T2.position = 'Vice President'

SELECT T2.state
FROM member AS T1
JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Sacha' AND T1.last_name = 'Harrison';

SELECT T1.department
FROM major AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major
WHERE T2.position = 'President';

SELECT income.date_received
FROM income
JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Connor'
  AND member.last_name = 'Hilton'
  AND income.source = 'Dues';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.source = 'Dues'

LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(b.amount)
     FROM budget b
     JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
     WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement' 
       AND e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff')
    /
    (SELECT SUM(b.amount)
     FROM budget b
     JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
     WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement' 
       AND e.event_name = 'October Meeting') AS times_more;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.category = 'Parking' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(b.amount) AS parking_budget_percentage
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'November Speaker';
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) 
FROM zip_code 
WHERE county = 'Orange County' 
  AND state = 'Virginia';

SELECT T1.city, T1.county, T1.state
FROM zip_code AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.zip_code = T2.zip
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Amy' AND T2.last_name = 'Firth'

SELECT T1.expense_description
FROM expense AS T1
JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id

LIMIT 1;

FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member

FROM member

ORDER BY COUNT(major.college) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.phone = '809-555-3360';

SELECT event.event_name
FROM event
JOIN budget ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event
ORDER BY budget.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.expense_description
FROM expense AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id
WHERE T2.position = 'Vice President';

SELECT COUNT(T1.member_id)
FROM member AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
WHERE T3.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT T1.date_received
FROM income AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Casey' AND T2.last_name = 'Mason';

SELECT COUNT(member.member_id) 
FROM member 
INNER JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code 
WHERE zip_code.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT COUNT(T1.link_to_event) 
FROM attendance AS T1 
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id 
WHERE T2.phone = "954-555-6240";

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id
WHERE T2.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

FROM budget AS T1
JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id
WHERE T2.status = 'Closed'
GROUP BY T2.event_name
ORDER BY MAX(CAST(T1.spent AS REAL) / NULLIF(T1.amount, 0)) DESC

SELECT MAX(spent) FROM budget;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM event 
WHERE type = 'Meeting' 
  AND strftime('%Y', event_date) = '2020';

FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
JOIN major AS T4 ON T1.link_to_major = T4.major_id

  AND T4.major_name = 'Interior Design'

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code
WHERE T2.city = 'Georgetown'
  AND T2.state = 'South Carolina'

SELECT SUM(T1.amount) 
FROM income AS T1 
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id 
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Grant' AND T2.last_name = 'Gilmour';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN income i ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id

SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_expense
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name, income.source
FROM member
JOIN income ON member.member_id = income.link_to_member
WHERE income.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM income);

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' AND l.status = 'C';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND T2.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND T2.A11 > 8000;

SELECT dp.account_id,
       MAX(d2.A11) OVER () - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
CROSS JOIN district d2
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC,
         d.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T3.account_id
FROM client AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
JOIN disp AS T3 ON T3.client_id = T1.client_id
WHERE T1.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND T2.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T3.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND T2.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT T1.client_id
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T3.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND T2.type = 'DISPONENT'

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.status = 'C'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) = '1997'
  AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY T2.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id
INNER JOIN account AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND T2.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE date = (
    SELECT MIN(date)
    FROM trans
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
);

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE account.date < '970101'
  AND trans.balance > 3000;

SELECT disp.client_id
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT T2.date 
FROM trans AS T1 
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id 
WHERE T1.amount = 840 AND T1.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id
FROM account
JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25';

SELECT MAX(trans.amount)
FROM trans
JOIN disp ON trans.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d    ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c  ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN trans t   ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
  AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT T1.disp_id
FROM disp AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.amount = 5100
  AND T2.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND account.date LIKE '96%';

SELECT T4.A2
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T1.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM client
JOIN disp  ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN loan  ON disp.account_id  = loan.account_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832
  AND loan.date   = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE di.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT
  (
    ( SELECT t.balance
      FROM trans t
      JOIN loan l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
      WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
        AND t.date = '1998-12-27'
      ORDER BY l.loan_id
      LIMIT 1 )
    -
    ( SELECT t.balance
      FROM trans t
      JOIN loan l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
      WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
        AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
      ORDER BY l.loan_id
      LIMIT 1 )
  ) * 100.0
  /
  ( SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN loan l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
      AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1 ) AS increase_rate

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage
FROM loan;

SELECT T1.account_id, T2.A2, T2.A3
FROM account AS T1
JOIN district AS T2
  ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
  AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT DISTINCT 
    a.account_id, 
    a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d     ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c   ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND di.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) + 1900 BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2, d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT 
    l.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3, d.A11
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT d.A2,
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN district.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE account.date LIKE '1993%';

SELECT T1.A2, COUNT(T2.client_id)
FROM district AS T1
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T2.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY T1.A2
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.client_id) DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_holders_without_card
FROM disp
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND disp.disp_id NOT IN (SELECT disp_id FROM card);

SELECT d.A3
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(loan.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan
JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M';

SELECT A3 AS branch_location,
       A2 AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13)
             FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(account_id)
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN loan ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND account.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(client_id)
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM card 
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id 
WHERE card.type = 'gold' 
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) 
FROM account AS T1 
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id 
WHERE T2.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" AS o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN card AS T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id
WHERE T3.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_total) AS avg_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
           SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)
) AS monthly_totals;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.client_id
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T3.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', T3.date) = '1998'
  AND T3.amount < (
      SELECT AVG(T4.amount)
      FROM trans AS T4
      WHERE T4.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND strftime('%Y', T4.date) = '1998'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND district.A3 = 'south Bohemia';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT d.type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND dt.A11 > 8000
  AND dt.A11 <= 9000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
JOIN trans ON trans.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND trans.bank = 'AB';

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district_name
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ';

SELECT AVG(d.A15) AS avg_crimes_1995
FROM district d
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
  AND d.district_id IN (
      SELECT a.district_id
      FROM account a
      WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) >= 97
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM card 
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id 
WHERE card.type = 'classic' 
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha' 
  AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

FROM client c
JOIN disp d   ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l   ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT d.A15
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE a.account_id = 532;

SELECT account.district_id
FROM account
JOIN "order" ON account.account_id = "order".account_id
WHERE "order".order_id = 33333;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN disp ON t.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 3356
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
WHERE amount < 200000 
  AND account_id IN (
      SELECT account_id 
      FROM account 
      WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  );

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     -
     SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    * 100.0 /
    SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) 
    AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp d
      JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
      WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
        AND c.gender = 'M'
  );

JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = '163109';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH > '500';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.ID,
       (STRFTIME('%Y', current_timestamp) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T2
JOIN Examination AS T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID
WHERE T1.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100 AND T2.colour = 'Brown'

SELECT hero_attribute.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN superhero ON hero_attribute.hero_id = superhero.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT s.id
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
INNER JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero
)

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END)  AS inpatient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END)  AS outpatient_count,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL)
        / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
    / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_to_outpatient_ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = '30609';

SELECT P.SEX, P.Birthday, E.`Examination Date`, E.Symptoms
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH > 500;

SELECT T1.ID,
       strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND T2.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Admission` = '+'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`Birthday`) AS INTEGER) >= 50;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997'
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND T2.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT T3.Symptoms, T3.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T2
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T2.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Birthday = (
    SELECT MAX(Birthday)
    FROM Patient
    WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination)
)
AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT T1.Date,
       (STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T2
JOIN Laboratory AS T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0) 
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS underage_patients
FROM Examination AS E
INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993'
  AND (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 18;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', T2.Date) BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', T3.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age,
       T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Patient AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
ORDER BY T2.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT ANA FROM Examination WHERE ID = 3605340 AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT CASE 
           WHEN "T-CHO" < 250 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_normal_level
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 2927464
  AND Date = '1995-09-04';

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY `First Date`
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
    AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' 
    AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13' 
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' 
  AND T2.`Date` LIKE '1995%'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT T2.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1959-03-01'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-09-27';

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(L.`T-CHO`) 
     FROM Laboratory L 
     JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID 
     WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18' 
       AND L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(L.`T-CHO`) 
     FROM Laboratory L 
     JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID 
     WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18' 
       AND L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%') AS decrease_rate;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` >= '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` < '1998-01-01';

SELECT DISTINCT ID
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND GPT > 30
  AND ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(ID) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'F' 
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' 
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, E.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND L.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(
         SUM(
           CASE 
             WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' 
                  AND (T2.TP < '6.0' OR T2.TP > '8.5') 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 
           END
         ) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
  ON T1.ID = T2.ID;

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Admission` = '+'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`Birthday`) AS INTEGER)) >= 50;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND Description LIKE '1997%'
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Examination.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER))
     - MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T2.Symptoms, T2.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = (
    SELECT MAX(Birthday)
    FROM Patient
    WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination)
)
AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31' 
  AND T1.SEX = 'M'

SELECT T1.Date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CAST(
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
         FROM Patient AS P
         JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
         WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0)
    AS REAL) /
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
     FROM Patient AS P
     JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
     WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5) AS male_to_female_ratio;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) 
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < '18' 
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(CAST(1999 AS REAL) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS REAL)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'

SELECT CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age,
       E.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS E
INNER JOIN Patient    AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
ORDER BY L.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT ANA FROM Examination WHERE ID = 3605340 AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY `First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.`aCL IgM` 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', T2.Description) = '1994-02-19' 
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13' 
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' 
  AND T2.Date LIKE '1995%'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT T1.Symptoms
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Birthday = '1959/3/1'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993/9/27';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)
    - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` >= '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` < '1998-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND GPT > 30
  AND ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(ID), ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND ANA = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`)
      FROM Examination
  ) * 1.2;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
WHERE T1.`U-PRO` > 0 AND T1.`U-PRO` < 30

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', `First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-'
  AND T2.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND T2.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989';

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(T1.ALB) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SEX = 'F' 
  AND T1.PLT > 400 
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS num_female_aps_patients
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND Diagnosis = 'APS';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE strftime('%Y', DATE) = '1997' 
  AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
     / SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND P.Admission = '-'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 1997;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.WBC < 3.5

SELECT JULIANDAY(E.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = 821298;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Patient.ID = 57266 
  AND ((Laboratory.UA > 8.0 AND Patient.SEX = 'M') 
       OR (Laboratory.UA > 6.5 AND Patient.SEX = 'F'))
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = '48473' AND GOT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT < 60
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', L.Date) = '1994';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT > 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP < 300

SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.TP < 6.0

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 
FROM Patient AS T 
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON T.ID = L.ID 
WHERE T.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - not within normal range'
    END AS ALB_Status
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
       / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID;

SELECT AVG(L.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
    OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5))
  AND L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
      );

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` = (SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT T1.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T2.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY T1.SEX

SELECT T1.ID, T1."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1."T-CHO" = (
    SELECT MAX("T-CHO")
    FROM Laboratory
)
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

FROM Patient AS T1

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU >= 180
  AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250;

FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991'

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5
   OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY
    P.SEX ASC,
    P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    P.Diagnosis,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Admission

INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT >= 52

FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

  AND T2.element = 'br';

FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label

SELECT COUNT(bond_id)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT T1.PLT
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND T1.PLT > 100
  AND T1.PLT < 400;

SELECT AVG(T2.PT)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis IN (1, 2)
  AND T3.PT < 14;

SELECT bond_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)

SELECT molecule.molecule_id

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)

SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id

);

SELECT DISTINCT T3.element
FROM bond AS T1

SELECT m.molecule_id

SELECT T2.atom_id2

JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

         SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0

         5
       ) AS percentage
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1

SELECT T3.bond_type

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

SELECT a.element

        WHERE m2.label = '-'

SELECT T2.bond_type

);

                     )
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0
       / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage

JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT element
FROM atom

SELECT bond_id

);

    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0

3) AS percent

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label

SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id

JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(b.bond_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
        GROUP BY molecule_id
    ) AS sub
);

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id) / COUNT(T2.atom_id) AS average_bonds

SELECT T2.element

GROUP BY b.molecule_id

SELECT a.element

JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T3.atom_id, T3.element

JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element

         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
         5
       ) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT T2.atom_id2

JOIN connected AS T2

SELECT DISTINCT T2.bond_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element)

JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

SELECT T1.bond_id

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id

JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id

SELECT label

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)

  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT molecule.label

JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

       b.molecule_id,

       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond AS b

JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
         WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'Non-Carcinogenic' 
       END AS carcinogenic_status

JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)

     WHERE b.bond_type = '#') * 100.0

SELECT T2.label

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, atom.element

SELECT b.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

SELECT DISTINCT atom.molecule_id, atom.element

SELECT a1.element, a2.element

JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 'c'
  AND T4.bond_type = '#'
  AND T1.label = '-'
LIMIT 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR001';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT A1.element, A2.element
FROM connected AS C
JOIN atom AS A1 ON C.atom_id = A1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS A2 ON C.atom_id2 = A2.atom_id
WHERE C.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(*), atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.element) AS hydrogen_ratio,
       T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 
     ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY T2.label;

SELECT CASE 
           WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
           ELSE 'Non-Carcinogenic' 
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.bond_type
